strategy: Aberrant spectres can be assigned as a Slayer task at level 60 Slayer and level 65 combat by various Slayer masters. They can be found in the Stronghold Slayer Cave, the second floor of the Slayer Tower, and in Deepfin Mine.

A nose peg or Slayer helmet is required when fighting aberrant spectres. Without either of those equipped, they will use a special attack which hits through protection prayers and drain the player's stats very quickly.

Aberrant spectres have a normal magic attack that has a max hit of 8. Protect from Magic will completely neutralize it. With Bigger and badder unlocked, the Superior variation, the Abhorrent spectre may spawn. The Abhorrent has a max hit of 33, and Protect from Magic will still prevent its normal damage.
summary: Aberrant spectres use a magic attack with a max hit of 8 that Protect from Magic fully negates, but without a nose peg or Slayer helmet they use a special attack that hits through prayer and drains stats fast. They are undead, so a Salve amulet (ei) beats the Slayer helmet bonus, and they drop lots of herbs and seeds so a herb sack and seed box are recommended. The Stronghold Slayer Cave is the usual choice because a cannon can be used there, Nieve or Steve is right outside and a bank is close; the Slayer Tower gives bonus Slayer XP from the Morytania Diary. Deviant spectres in the Catacombs count too but have much higher defence and give lower XP rates.

trainingSummary.cons: Cannot be lured into double-hit cannon spots properly, which results in mediocre experience rates.
trainingSummary.pros: Relatively low-effort task. Valuable herbs and seeds cover most of the costs of using the cannon.

exampleSetups.label: Catacombs magic
exampleSetups.notes:
This is the recommended equipment for barraging or bursting abyssal demons in the Catacombs of Kourend.

Abyssal demons in the Catacombs are excellent experience due to the AoE effect of ancients; The chambers contain plenty of spawns that can be grouped together for barraging or bursting, making them highly suited for multitarget strategies. This means they're some of the highest slayer experience in the game, and therefore the bracelet of slaughter is preferable over a tormented bracelet or confliction gauntlet as it will increase task length. This is especially true for player looking to train their slayer and magic levels.

Because abyssal demons have low magic defence, magic damage and prayer bonus should be prioritised over magic accuracy. Magic attack bonuses are far less important than damage multipliers.

Items that increase magic damage are especially valuable when bursting or barraging abyssal demons. Kodai wand provides +15% magic damage bonus as well as infinite water runes and a chance to save runes, making it the most effective weapon used here.

The Elidinis' ward (f) is the best off-hand, offering a +5% Magic damage bonus, significantly increasing damage output. The occult necklace also provides +5% Magic damage and is a staple choice, while the tormented bracelet offers further magic damage, though this should be swapped for a bracelet of slaughter to extend the task. Other useful pieces include the Virtus robes which are optimal for casting ancient…

exampleSetups.label: Catacombs ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
With the venator bow, ranging abyssal demons becomes a viable alternative to barraging them. While it is less efficient, it also requires much less effort as the bow will often tag new abyssal demons without the player's input.

With 90 Magic and completion of A Kingdom Divided (and Dragon Slayer II for Ironman wrath rune access), they can provide strong Prayer training. Using Master Reanimation on ensouled heads and Demonic Offering on ashes yields ~307 Prayer experience per kill, over double their Slayer experience, without leaving the area.

exampleSetups.label: Wilderness slayer cave
exampleSetups.notes:
Abyssal demons can be killed in the Wilderness slayer cave. This area is multicombat and allows use of a dwarf multicannon, but as with all Wilderness activities, players should avoid risking items they aren't willing to lose.
It can, however, greatly speed up the task and provide a consistent supply of aggression. The cannon will not be lost if you die while it is placed on the ground. A one-click teleport (such as a royal seed pod) is strongly recommended in case of player killers.

The accursed sceptre (a) is notable here, as it provides a 50% boost to both Magic accuracy and damage against any NPC in the Wilderness, making it a powerful option. This effect stacks with the slayer helmet (i). Players should 3-item, or 4-item if using Protect Item, keeping only their sceptre and a few key magic strength pieces as their core items that are kept on death. The rest of the setup can consist of inexpensive equipment, such as monk's robes, bracelet of slaughter, and free items like the completed book of darkness.

Blighted supplies are recommended for food and prayer restoration as well as blighted ice sacks. This is because they are inexpensive and top tier, but can only be used in the wilderness.

Because abyssal demons have low magic defence, magic damage and prayer bonus should be prioritised over magic accuracy. Magic attack bonuses are far less important than damage multipliers and prayer.

It is strongly recommended to use goading potions or a cannon to gain aggression…

exampleSetups.label: Melee
exampleSetups.notes:
Meleeing abyssal demons offers good experience and easily allows the player access to the Arceuus spellbook for offering spells, thralls, and death charge. If in the Slayer tower bonus experience will also be awarded, scaling with completion of the Morytania Diary.

Use of demonbane weaponry like Arclight or Emberlight is strongly recommended for highest damage output.

strategy: At level 85 Slayer and Combat level, the player may be assigned Abyssal demons by mid and high levelled Slayer Masters and Krystilia. They can be found in the Abyssal Area, the Catacombs of Kourend, the Wilderness Slayer Cave, and in the Slayer Tower, where they are found on the third floor and in the task-only basement.

Abyssal demons use a fairly accurate melee stab attack, but with a relatively low max hit of 8. With Bigger and badder unlocked, the Greater abyssal demon has a chance to spawn as a Superior slayer monster. The greater abyssal demon is much more powerful and accurate with a max hit of 27. Protect from Melee will neutralise all damage taken from either variation.
Players on abyssal demon tasks may also opt to kill the Abyssal Sire boss instead, which can be very profitable as compensation for significantly lower experience rates compared to Abyssal demons.

The Wilderness Slayer Cave is the only location in which a Cannon can be used against Abyssal demons, although as part of the Wilderness, it is also a Player killing hotspot. The Wilderness Slayer Cave also allows taking advantage of cheaper Blighted supplies and the passive effects of the Accursed sceptre (a) and other weapons charged with Revenant ether.

With their 1x1 size, Abyssal demons are ideal for use with area of effect weapons including the Venator bow and Ancient Magicks. The Catacombs and Wilderness Slayer Cave are the only two Multicombat areas with Abyssal demons. As Abyssal demons are not aggressive, a method to cause them to attack the player, such as Dinh's bulwark or a Goading potion, is recommended.

Because of the teleportation mechanic, Smoke Barrage or Smoke Burst are favoured over their Ice equivalents. After teleporting away, frozen abyssal demons will not move back toward the player until they're unfrozen. Blood spells are significantly more expensive than Smoke and are not recommended.

Killing Abyssal demons outside multicombat areas, usually done only on a Konar task, will result in a slower task requiring more attention. If required to kill Abyssal demons in a single combat zone, it's recommended to use an Expeditious bracelet with a melee setup.

If the player is comfortable with the risk, Abyssal demons in the Wilderness Slayer Cave will provide some of the best rates of Slayer experience in the game. Abyssal demons in the Catacombs are still an outstanding source of experience.

In single-combat areas such as the Slayer Tower a melee setup with an Expeditious bracelet is recommended. Extend this task as early as possible.

strategy: The Abyssal Sire is an abyssal demon Slayer boss that requires level 85 Slayer to kill. To access the boss, the player must have visited the Abyss at least once, either through the Mage of Zamorak or the Fairy Ring network. As with all other Slayer bosses, the Sire can only be fought when assigned abyssal demons (outside of Krystilia) or itself as a Slayer task. Although it resides in a multi-combat area, it is a solo-only boss.

According to The Overseer, the Abyssal Sires are the engineers of the Abyss from a time before the God Wars. As their resources began to deplete and they had no means to escape, they constructed the Nexus and remained there in deep stasis.

It is known for dropping the unsired, which can be placed in the Font of Consumption behind The Overseer for a chance of obtaining an abyssal whip, abyssal dagger, abyssal head, jar of miasma, a part of the abyssal bludgeon - the axon, claw, or spine - or, rarely, an abyssal orphan.

exampleSetups.label: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
Prayer bonus is prioritised over ranged accuracy because of the boss's relatively low defensive stats and the minimal damage taken when dealing with the mechanics correctly. Alternatively, players may use gear that maximizes ranged accuracy if they are confident with prayer flicking, as it greatly reduces the need for prayer potions. With sufficient experience, barely any damage should be taken most kills; the only unavoidable damage players may take is the first hit at the start of kill, and self-inflicted damage from Divine potions or the special attack of Ruby bolts (e).

Inventory:

- About 4–20 prayer potions or super restores.
- More prayer potions allows for longer trips at the cost of not being able to bank hydra bones; however, banking the bones will lower overall kill rates due to time spent running to and from a bank, and is not recommended without Rada's blessing 4.
- About 4-10 food, preferrably Cooked moonlight antelope.
- As the player becomes more proficient at fighting this boss, they should take very little damage per kill, so excess food can be replaced with more prayer potions if doing long trips.
- Antidote++ if not bringing cooked moonlight antelope.
- Divine ranging potion, ranging potion, or bastion potion (the latter is largely superfluous, as all damage taken in the fight can be mitigated with prayer and good positioning once the player is experienced enough)
- House tablets or rings of dueling to restore stats and bank
- Rada's blessing 4 for fast…

exampleSetups.label: Melee #1
exampleSetups.notes:
- Strength bonus is preferred over prayer bonus for melee.
- Melee setups often provide similar damage output to range setups, especially when a good special attack weapon is available, and typically have lower to no upkeep cost for weapons and armour.
- When meleeing Hydra, effectively luring it over the vents without missing attacks can be more complex than using a range setup.
- Despite having low defence, the Hydra has enough health that a small improvement in DPS from defence reduction adds up greatly over the course of the fight.
- On average, unless the ultor ring adds a max hit of 5 to a dragon hunter lance, lightbearer and a strong spec weapon will result in faster kill times.
- Damaging special attacks should be used during the flame phase to maximise the chance of phasing him before the flame wall attacks, except for when using burning claws, as this phase specifically is immune to burn damage.
- Learning to skip the flame phase will significantly speed up kill times and reduce the chance to take damage during the phase.

Inventory (If banking bones):

- 1 Divine super combat potion or Super combat potion.
- 4-5 Prayer potions, find what works for you. Each kill should take around 1:45-2:15 with close to max gear and stats. Prayer flicking can help make the most out of the potions, allowing for more efficient trips.
- Special attack weapon, or multiple if using lightbearer. Any defence reduction special to use at the start of kills, and then spare special attack…

strategy: The Alchemical Hydra is a boss version of hydra, found in the lower level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm, requiring level 95 Slayer to kill. The Alchemical Hydra was the creation of a Dragonkin named Karuulm. While Karuulm saw promise in his creation, he nevertheless saw it as a failure because he could not replicate its traits, and abandoned it along with his other creations: the Wyrms, Drakes, and Hydras.

Unlike normal hydras, the Alchemical Hydra can only be killed while on a hydra Slayer task, which are only assigned by Konar quo Maten and Mortimer. Likewise, it can be assigned for boss slayer, but only by Konar.

In addition, as it is found within the volcano, players who have not completed the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary must wear boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots to protect themselves from the extreme heat of the dungeon floor. This also applies to attempting to use the Item Retrieval Service, where the rapid damage will interrupt actions and dying a second time will wipe the storage.
summary: The Alchemical Hydra is the hydra boss on the lower level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon, requiring 95 Slayer; it can only be killed on a hydra task (Konar or Mortimer) or a Konar boss task, and boots of stone, brimstone or granite boots are needed in the dungeon without the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary.

strategy: Ankou can be assigned as a Slayer task at level 40 combat by various Slayer masters. They can be found in the Sepulcher of Death, Stronghold Slayer Cave, the Catacombs of Kourend, and Deepfin Mine, as well as in the Wilderness in both the Wilderness Slayer Cave and the The Forgotten Cemetery. There are five variations of normal Ankou ranging from level 75 to 98. An additional variation, Dark Ankou, only appear when fighting the boss Skotizo, but they spawn infrequently and are almost always ignored in order to kill the boss faster. Damaged Dark Ankou that automatically die after Skotizo is killed will not count for a Slayer task.
Ankou attack with a relatively inaccurate melee attack that has a max hit from 8 to 10. Protect from Melee can be used to negate all damage.

Ankou are undead, therefore the Salve amulet and its variations can give a bonus to the player's accuracy and damage. The bonuses of the Salve amulet do not stack with the bonuses given by the Slayer helmet or Black mask. It is advised to check a Dps calculator with the player's current stats and other gear to determine if the Slayer helmet or the Salve amulet should be used.
summary: Ankou use an inaccurate melee attack with a max hit of 8-10 that Protect from Melee fully negates. They are undead, so a Salve amulet works (but not stacked with the Slayer helmet), and they are aggressive. Unextended tasks are fast with melee even in single combat; in the multi-combat Catacombs of Kourend or Wilderness Slayer Cave they can be bursted or barraged, and a cannon works everywhere except the Catacombs. The Stronghold Slayer Cave is the convenient default (cannon, task-only, near Nieve).

strategy: Aquanites are Slayer monsters found in the Ynysdail Cavern beneath Ynysdail. They require level 78 Slayer to fight, and accessing Ynysdail itself requires 73 Sailing and a boat equipped with an adamant keel or better.

Aquanites can be killed normally and Mortimer can assign them as a Slayer task by default; however, to receive them as a Slayer task from Nieve or Duradel, players must first unlock them for 80 Slayer reward points. A task extension is also available for 100 points.
Aquanites can drop the unique Aquanite tendon, used to make the Aquanite hopper.

Accessing Ynysdail requires the player to enter the crystalline maze from the outside, or build the rowboat hotspot on the island. This rowboat, once built, will generate another one north of Gwenith. Using this rowboat requires completion of Song of the Elves. It is recommended to complete the quest to avoid having to set the ship back to a mooring point if a greater teleport focus is not on it.
summary: Aquanites are accurate magic attackers found only in the Ynysdail Cavern, so Protect from Magic is strongly recommended; alternatively they can be safespotted with a 9-10 tile attack range. Hitting one with a slash attack severs its lure and drops its stab defence from 60 to 10, so the usual method is a fast slash weapon followed by a strong stab weapon. The cavern is single-way and a cannon cannot be placed. Reaching Ynysdail needs 73 Sailing and a boat with an adamant keel or better; building the rowboat there (70 Construction) gives a fast route from Gwenith after Song of the Elves.

strategy: Araxxor is the boss version of araxytes found within the Morytania Spider Cave, requiring level 92 Slayer and access to Morytania to kill. As a Slayer boss, he may only be killed while on a spider or araxyte Slayer task. Konar quo Maten can also assign Araxxor specifically when she assigns a boss task.

Araxxor is currently the strongest Slayer boss in-game by combat level. He uniquely drops pieces of the noxious halberd, a strong two-handed slash weapon, and the araxyte fang, which can be combined with the amulet of torture to create the amulet of rancour, the best-in-slot melee amulet.
summary: Araxxor is the araxyte Slayer boss in his own cavern of the Morytania Spider Cave; he needs 92 Slayer (boostable from 87 on a spiders task) and Morytania access, and can only be killed on a spider or araxyte task or a boss task.

exampleSetups.label: Normal Araxytes
exampleSetups.notes:
When completing a task of normal araxytes, it is highly recommended the player avoids killing any level 96 araxytes; their drop table is worse than the level 146 variant and they are notably unable to spawn their superior, the dreadborn araxyte. Only the level 146 variants will spawn them, so entire tasks of normal araxytes should be done with the stronger ones. While they are mixed in the main chamber, there are three on-task caves east from it, the northern cave is a single-way zone with level 146 araxytes, while the eastern and southern caves are multi-way zones with level 96 and 146 variants respectively.

A task of normal araxytes is very profitable, as they have many stackable and/or alchemy drops. Both a seed box and herb sack are highly recommended. Even with a cannon, players will generally profit off the task, especially when picking up Araxyte venom sacs. At high kill rates such as when using a cannon players may find it useful to set the araxtyes attack option to right click due to the high speed of venom sac and double loot drops to reduce click intensity.

A dwarf multicannon can also be used throughout the cave, and can kill araxytes very quickly in multicombat areas. This should ideally be combined with a venator bow, due to the larger araxytes' 2x2 hitboxes making barrages harder to utilise. However, by running diagonally through an araxyte repeatedly, it is possible to stack them for barraging. Bracelets of slaughter can be used to extend the task.

exampleSetups.label: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
This method is only recommended for killing Aviansie in the regular God Wars Dungeon. Players should equip themselves with best-in-slot ranged gear, and wear Armadyl-affiliated clothing, as well as a Zamorak-related item, or else everything in the vicinity will be aggressive. A Saradomin item is worth wearing as well since players have to get past some Saradomin creatures. For better tanking, players could wear Verac's plateskirt and/or a good melee shield instead. Also, bones can be converted into peaches for additional food with either the Bones to Peaches spell itself or the tabs.

Inventory:

- Some divine ranging potions
- A Super restore if Fire of Unseasonal Warmth is not present
- A rope (only if first time)
- Any crossbow + Mith grapple (or Fletching cape)
- Some food for incidental damage
- Rune pouch with Alch runes
- Herb sack (optional)
- Soul bearer (optional)
- An emergency teleport (optional)

exampleSetups.label: Low Risk
exampleSetups.notes:
This method is strongly recommended for killing Aviansie in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon. As always in the Wilderness, players should keep risk to a minimal but wear god items to maintain tolerance in the facility. Players can utilise either the Prayer approach by activating Protect from Missiles and attacking an Aviansie or the tank method with monkfish or better.

- 1-2 Prayer potions (optional—no more than 6 if using Prayer method)
- Royal seed pod or another emergency teleport
- Looting bag
- Rest monkfish or better

exampleSetups.label: Low Risk Melee
exampleSetups.notes:
This method is strongly recommended for killing Aviansie in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon. As always in the Wilderness, players should keep risk to a minimal but wear god items to maintain tolerance in the facility. Players can utilise either the Prayer approach by activating Protect from Missiles and attacking an Aviansie.

With Noxious halberd you can tag and venom all Avianses to get faster kills.

Recommended equipment can be different but is an example of low cost equipment providing full protection against all NPCs.

exampleSetups.label: Kree'arra: Tumeken's Shadow
exampleSetups.notes:
Tumeken's shadow is currently the only weapon capable of killing Kree'arra directly that is competitive with black chinchompas. Note that it is dramatically more effective than any other magic weapon in this encounter, dealing roughly three times as much damage as the next strongest option. As such, no other magic weapons are recommended for killing Kree'arra directly.

Inventory:

- Eldritch Nightmare staff to autocast Ancient Magicks or something else such as a Kodai wand or Blood ancient sceptre
- The eldritch Nightmare staff not only autocasts Ancient Magicks, but also has a special attack that restores Prayer which can be used on the melee or ranged minion
- Elidinis' ward (f) to pair with the Ancient Magick switch
- Ecumenical key to get into the room
- 3-5 Saradomin brews
- 5-7 super restores
- High-healing food such as anglerfish or manta rays
- Any crossbow with a mith grapple to get to the lair, if not already using a crossbow
- One-click teleport
- Rune pouch with necessary runes to cast Blood Barrage to heal off the minions and ice spells to freeze Flight Kilisa.
- Imbued heart or its saturated version to boost Magic level.
- Any necessary god items and/or secondary bolt if using any (optional)
- Trollheim Teleport

exampleSetups.label: Kree'arra: Chinchompas
exampleSetups.notes:
By using chinchompas, one can kill Kree'arra quickly even if they are soloing, though it is also expensive.

To use this method, stand in the south-western corner of the room and wait for both Kree'arra and Flight Kilisa, the melee bodyguard, to close in on you.

When both are in position, start throwing chinchompas at Flight Kilisa; the chinchompas will almost always hit her due to her lower Defence, and the AoE damage will hit Kree'arra.

Inventory:

- Toxic blowpipe for killing the minions and specs
- Bow of Faerdhinen to hit Kree'arra when he and Flight Kilisa are not stacked, which happens at spawn and if Flight Kilisa dies before Kree'arra
- Blood ancient sceptre or something else to autocast blood spells such as a Kodai wand or ancient staff
- The eldritch Nightmare staff not only autocasts Ancient Magicks, but also has a special attack that restores Prayer which can be used on the melee or ranged minion
- Ecumenical key to get into the room
- 2+ bastion potions or ranging potions
- 6-10 Saradomin brews depending on your combats and if you are using Blood Barrage
- 11+ super restores
- Bones to peaches tab for extra healing
- Any crossbow with a mith grapple to get to the lair, if not already using a crossbow
- One-click teleport
- Rune pouch with necessary runes to cast Blood Barrage to heal off the minions
- Any necessary god items and/or secondary bolt if using any (optional)
- Trollheim Teleport

exampleSetups.label: Kree'arra: Tbow / Bowfa
exampleSetups.notes:
The Twisted Bow and Bow of Faerdhinen are both viable methods for killing Kree'arra. While weaker than Black Chinchompas, they're much cheaper to use and less click intensive.

Twisted Bow is stronger than the Bow of Faerdhinen if the player has Masori armour (f) and Dragon arrows—if missing two of those three items, the Bow of Faerdhinen with Crystal armour is stronger.

Players should stand under Kree'arra after each hit to minimise the amount of attacks Kree'arra can use against the player, especially if using a Twisted Bow as its attack speed is slower than Bow of Faerdhinen

Inventory:

- Toxic blowpipe for killing the minions and specs
- Blood ancient sceptre or something else to autocast blood spells such as a Kodai wand or ancient staff
- The eldritch Nightmare staff not only autocasts Ancient Magicks, but also has a special attack that restores Prayer which can be used on the melee or ranged minion
- Ecumenical key to get into the room
- 2+ bastion potions
- 6-10 Saradomin brews depending on your combats and if you are using Blood Barrage
- 8-10 super restores
- Bones to peaches tab for extra healing
- Any crossbow with a mith grapple to get to the lair. The grapple can be held within Dizana's quiver if owned.
- Rune pouch with necessary runes to cast Blood Barrage to heal off the minions
- Any necessary god items
- 2 Trollheim Teleports - Revert one after teleporting Trollheim to get a house teleport back.
- Bracelet of slaughter to extend slayer tasks if applicable

exampleSetups.label: Kree'arra: Melee (soulflame horn)
exampleSetups.notes:
Even though Kree'arra has extremely high melee defences, the special attack of the soulflame horn can be used to make the player's next melee hit always land. Since the horn's special attack only works if another player is near the user, it is mandatory to kill Kree'arra in a small team with this method, with duos and trios working the best. Additionally, the player must be using a halberd since Kree'arra is airborne; the noxious halberd is the only viable halberd for this method.

All players should stand under Kree'arra after every attack, and use the soulflame horn's special attack while under him. While it is possible for a team to use only one soulflame horn and simply trade the horn between players after killing the minions, it is recommended for all players to have a soulflame horn in the event the player currently using the horn uses all of their special attacks (and thus guaranteed hits for the party) before Kree'arra is dead.

Despite melee armour giving high ranged defence bonuses, it is still recommended to pray Protect from Missiles to avoid potentially getting comboed by Kree'arra. Switch to Protect from Magic after Kree'arra dies to kill the magic minion.

Inventory:

- Soulflame horn
- Lightbearer to switch to after a kill if using another ring (e.g. ultor ring)
- Rune pouch with necessary runes to cast Blood Barrage and Ice Barrage if using Ancient Magicks, or Death Charge if using the Arceuus spellbook
- While water runes for Ice Barrage are optional, it…

monsters.aggressive: Yes, unless wearing an Armadyl-affiliated item
monsters.name: Aviansie

requiredItems: Ranged or Magic weapon (or a halberd / salamander)
strategy: Aviansie can be assigned as a slayer task provided that players have access to the God Wars Dungeon (requiring completion of Death Plateau) and has unlocked Watch the birdie slayer perk for 80 Slayer reward points.

Aviansie can be found in the normal and Wilderness God Wars Dungeon; as followers of Armadyl, Armadylean God-aligned items are required to make them tolerant. Aviansie have an increased sense of danger and will attack players if they are attacked, even if they're in combat with another monster. Their flying height means that they can only be harmed with ranged and magic, although salamanders and halberds are an exception as a direct target.

Aviansie have a somewhat generous drop table that mostly revolves around adamantite bars, runite limbs, ensouled aviansie heads and poisoned rune daggers, the limbs and daggers having reasonable high alchemy price. Aviansies in the God Wars Dungeon will only drop the bars noted if the player has completed the Hard Fremennik Diary, whereas those in the Wilderness drop them noted regardless of diary completion. Though unlikely, it is possible to be killed by other players in the Wilderness, and its dangers force players to bring less than optimal gear if minimising risk.
styleNotes: Low Risk Melee: Ranged - Low Risk
summary: Aviansies fly, so they can only be hit with Ranged or Magic (halberds and salamanders are the melee exceptions), and they attack with Ranged. They are Armadylean followers: an Armadyl-aligned item makes them tolerant, but they will still turn on you the moment you attack one. The task must be unlocked with Watch the birdie (80 points) and needs God Wars Dungeon access; the God Wars Dungeon is the normal spot (multi, no cannon, Hard Fremennik Diary notes the adamant bars), while the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon (entrance at level 28 Wilderness) drops bars noted regardless of diary. Many players kill Kree'arra and his bodyguards instead, banking at Nex.

trainingSummary.cons: Poor experience rates. Killing Kree'arra effectively requires very expensive equipment, and the profit is very inconsistent due to the value mostly being in the rare unique drops.
trainingSummary.pros: Kree'arra can be killed on task for good profit.

The bandits are guarded by Guard Bandit. These bandits are aggressive, so players should take caution when approaching the camp. However, camp leaders (like Donny the lad) are not aggressive.
summary: Bandits are a Krystilia-only Wilderness task done at the Bandit Camp in level 17-24 Wilderness, a multi-combat area where a cannon makes the task go very quickly. The level 22 guard bandits and level 130 bandits at the southern entrance are aggressive, so enter from the safer eastern entrance (guarded only by giant rats) and consider trapping five of the level 130s inside the pizza shop and general store houses. Guard Bandits, Speedy Keith, Donny the lad and Black Heather all count. A single level 130 bandit in the Wilderness Slayer Cave also counts but is not recommended.

locations.name: Slayer Tower
locations.notes: 8 banshees on the eastern side of the ground floor; safespot 2 squares south of the torch at the south side of the stairs with the banshees east of the stairs. Killing one here is a Morytania easy diary task, and Slayer Tower kills get the Morytania Diary XP bonus.

requiredItems: Earmuffs or Slayer helmet
strategy: Banshees can be assigned as a Slayer task at level 15 Slayer and level 20 combat by various Slayer masters. They are found in the Slayer Tower and the Catacombs of Kourend. Players must wear earmuffs or a Slayer helm when fighting banshees. Lower levelled players who do not have access to a Slayer helm can wear a salve amulet. Note that the bonuses from the salve amulet do not stack with those from the Slayer helmet.
Banshees are primarily known for their common drops of pure essence, which is helpful for ironmen for runecrafting.

A stronger variant of banshee, the Twisted Banshee, can be found in the Catacombs of Kourend. These are often killed over normal banshees as they are still easy to kill (notably being safespottable) and have much better drops; battlestaves, rune equipment, and larger quantities of herbs.
summary: Banshees are a low-level task that requires earmuffs or a Slayer helmet, otherwise their scream deals damage and heavily drains stats. They are undead, so a Salve amulet works for players without a Slayer helmet. Normal banshees are on the ground floor of the Slayer Tower (single-way, safespot south of the stairs); Twisted Banshees in the Catacombs of Kourend are usually preferred because they are still easy, safespottable on the bridge between their rooms, and drop far better loot (battlestaves, rune items, herbs, pure essence). Neither location allows a cannon.

exampleSetups.label: Magic (Low level)
exampleSetups.notes:
Due to the elemental weakness of the Barrows brothers, and their low magic level, very little gear is needed to kill them. Some players prefer to wear tankier armour to defend against the crypt monsters, but even low level magic armour is generally more effective.

Inventory:

- If your Ranged level is high enough, bring Dragonhide armour and a ranged weapon for Ahrim.
- Use a melee weapon to kill monsters in the tunnels for reward potential.
- A Dragon dagger for quickly killing Ahrim.
- Food for healing from Verac or the crypt monsters.
- Prayer potions
- Combat and Ranging potions
- Restore potion for Ahrim's Strength drain
- Runes for Air spells or Iban Blast.
- Use the dueling ring to teleport to Ferox Enclave after each run, to bank and use the Pool of Refreshment to restore your stats. Otherwise bring a ring to boost your melee attacks for getting reward potential.

exampleSetups.label: Magic (High level)
exampleSetups.notes:
Magic can be used effectively against each Barrows brother. However, Ahrim is weakest to ranged and will be harder to hit without Air spells or a Tumeken's shadow.

Inventory:

- With a 1-handed staff, a Ghommal's hilt 2 or better can replace a magic offhand if you wish to avoid the prayer drain effect.
- Range equipment for Ahrim. With Air spells or a Tumeken's shadow this can be skipped for fewer equipment switches.
- Melee equipment for melee special attacks or getting reward potential.
- A saturated heart or other magic potion will boost powered staves considerably.
- Super combat and Ranging potions will speed up killing Ahrim and Karil.
- Restore potion for Karil's Agility drain and Ahrim's Strength drain.
- Use the rune pouch to store any mind, chaos, death and blood runes in.
- A Spade to enter the crypts.
- Teleport to house tablets could be replaced by a Construction cape or max cape.
- Barrows teleport tablets could be replaced with the barrows teleport in the Portal Nexus.
- Bringing a Strange old lockpick helps speed up runs by skipping through any doors in the crypts.

locations.notes: Reach by Barrows Teleport (Arceuus, 83 Magic) or a Barrows teleport tablet / house portal, the Shades of Mort'ton minigame teleport, fairy ring BIP with the 50 Agility stepping stone, Kharyrll teleport, or Drakan's medallion to Ver Sinhaza then the boat to Burgh de Rott.

strategy: The Barrows brothers were a band of six legendary Saradominist warriors from a small town in Misthalin who ventured into Morytania during the God Wars, leading the Morytania Campaign. Their fate is revealed in the crumbling tome. They struck a deal with a mysterious stranger for power, and after their deaths, the Stranger came to 'collect' them, and they were buried in six burial mounds, or Barrows, in eastern Morytania, giving them their collective name. Even after their deaths, they remain as wights. Their names are in alphabetical order from the oldest brother (Ahrim), to the youngest (Verac).
They can be killed by players as part of the Barrows minigame.
Barrows brothers can be assigned as a boss Slayer task.
summary: The six Barrows brothers (Ahrim, Dharok, Guthan, Karil, Torag and Verac) are fought in their burial mounds at the Barrows east of Mort'ton and can be assigned as a boss Slayer task with no Slayer level requirement beyond Priest in Peril for Morytania access; only brother kills count, not chests.

exampleSetups.label: Basilisk Knight: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
This is the best-in-slot available equipment for ranging the Basilisk Knights. The set up shown in this section currently costs approximately coins, plus the cost of darts.

Ranging is generally safer than melee, as you can safespot them with range in multiple locations behind the stalagmites. If ranging, it is recommended to bring runes to cast Telekinetic Grab to pickup drops while you still hold aggression after arriving.

Notes:

- Use Rapid heal prayer to offset the damage taken from the divine potions.
- Stand at least two tiles from the Basilisk Knights when attacking through the stalagmites.
- Flick the Rigour or Eagle Eye prayer if proficient enough, or leave them on and restore prayer points with the Super restores.
- Replace the Teleport to house (tablet) with a Construction cape, Crafting cape or Max cape.

exampleSetups.label: Basilisk Knight: Melee
exampleSetups.notes:
This is the best-in-slot available equipment for meleeing the Basilisk Knights. The set up shown in this section currently costs approximately coins. See the table below for an overview of equipment alternatives in case this setup is not accessible or too expensive. Note that at different (particularly higher) combat levels and gear upgrades, the fast crush weapons (like the Hasta or even Cudgel) may counterintuitively outperform much more expensive weapons like the Fang or Rapier.

Meleeing Basilisk Knights is generally the fastest option, especially in combination with a good special attack weapon. However, at lower defence levels or with worse gear, ranging may be quicker if you find yourself eating large amounts of food.

Notes:

- With a Waterbirth Island or Lunar Isle POH portal, a Divine rune pouch can hold runes for High alchemy and teleports to and from Basilisk Knights all in one inventory slot
- When killed, a Basilisk Knight will always drop Big bones, which can be converted into peaches with the Bones to Peaches spell or bones to peaches tablet. Peaches heal for 8 health each, meaning that trips can be extended drastically when doing sufficient kills.

exampleSetups.label: Basilisk Knight: Magic
exampleSetups.notes:
Notes:

- Players should use Protect from Magic and stay in a safe spot.
- Unlike with ranged, prayer gear is not recommended as mage accuracy has way more significant impact on dps.
- For ironman accounts mage setup offers comparable DPS to ranged at the benefit of not costing dragon ammunition or better dps than using rune knives / sunlight crossbow.
- Thralls can not be summoned in the Jormungand's prison's basilisk area.

requiredItems: Mirror shield or V's shield
strategy: Basilisks can be assigned as a Slayer task at level 40 Slayer, level 40 combat, and level 20 Defence by medium level Slayer Masters. The high level masters will not assign them until players unlock Basilocked using Slayer reward points. Ordinary basilisks, which can be found in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon and Jormungand's Prison, attack only using an extremely inaccurate melee attack with a max hit of 5. Their thin drop table and high defence level generally make them worthwhile to skip, although their low weighting doesn't make them worth blocking.

However, after completion of The Fremennik Exiles quest, the player gains access to the Basilisk Knight in Jormungand's Prison, and basilisk tasks gain a new purpose for obtaining the powerful Neitiznot faceguard.
When fighting any basilisk, the player must equip a mirror shield or V's shield, or the basilisk's gaze will deal immense damage and massively drain the player's stats.
summary: Basilisks are fought with melee using crush weapons, and a mirror shield or V's shield must be equipped or their gaze deals immense damage and drains stats. Ordinary basilisks in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon only use a weak melee attack and can be safespotted, but their thin drop table and high Defence make them slow. After The Fremennik Exiles most players kill Basilisk Knights in Jormungand's Prison for the basilisk jaw; knights use melee and magic and can be safespotted from melee, praying against whichever style is reaching you. Cannons cannot be placed anywhere with basilisks.

strategy: Bats can be assigned as a Slayer task from Turael, Spria, and Mazchna. They have a requirement of level 5 combat to be assigned and are generally meant as tasks for beginners. There are a variety of bats, but the most commonly killed are regular bats and giant bats. Bats only drop bat bones or nothing at all, meaning there is little reason to slay higher-level bats.
Although they are called bats, dire bats in Vampyrium do not count towards this Slayer task.
summary: A beginner task from Turael, Spria and Mazchna at 5 combat. Regular bats and giant bats are the usual targets because they die to any style and drop only bat bones, so there is no reason to seek higher-level variants. Silvarea (13 bats on the path to Paterdomus) and the Haunted Woods (13, not cannonable) are the largest surface clusters, Abandoned Mine level 1 holds 16, and the Coal Trucks or Taverley Dungeon giant bats are easy alternatives. Giant bats are aggressive to players of combat level 54 or lower.

exampleSetups.label: Callisto: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
Callisto has very low defence against ranged, and is particularly dangerous when up close. The ideal setup is 3-4 items to maximize ranged strength and accuracy, along with magical defence and tank equipment, such as a Dinh's bulwark, for PK'ers. In a team, consider having 1 group member equipped with a charged tome of water and runes to cast vulnerability to reduce Callisto's defence by 15% on a successful hit, increasing the group's DPS by around 5-7% depending on gear.

Equipment:

- References

Inventory:

- Looting bag
- Stamina potion (for running)
- Divine ranging potion
- Antidote++ (to cure poison from poison spiders). Can use Antidote+ mix for extra healing.
- Some prayer potions
- Some Blighted ancient ice sacks or Blighted entangle sacks to freeze Callisto.
- A Royal seed pod to teleport at level 30 Wilderness (if you choose not to wear Amulet of glory)
- Rest of inventory spaces to be filled with food (you may want to leave 2-3 slots empty for picking up items)

exampleSetups.label: Callisto: Magic
exampleSetups.notes:

Inventory:

- Stamina potion (for running)
- Saturated or Imbued heart (ensure it is protected), Forgotten brew, Ancient brew, or Divine magic potion
- Antidote++ (to cure poison from poison spiders). Can use Antidote+ mix for extra healing.
- Some prayer potions
- Some Blighted ancient ice sacks or Blighted entangle sacks to freeze Callisto
- A Royal seed pod to teleport at level 30 Wilderness (if you choose not to wear Amulet of glory)

- Rest of inventory spaces to be filled with food (you may want to leave 2-3 slots empty for picking up items)

exampleSetups.label: Artio: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
Webweaver is the strongest weapon against Artio. Ideally you want to maximize range damage, while keeping your magic attack bonus at 0 or higher to allow for guaranteed freezes on Artio. Gear like bloodbark boots, barrows gloves, imbued god capes, god books and ring of shadows are good to keep your magic bonus high enough, without sacrificing much range dps or incurring high risk. Defence bonus -- particularly magic defence -- is also beneficial for tanking PKers.

Equipment:

Note: Ensure items are protected. Do not take anything into the Wilderness you are not willing to lose. The PK skull prevention option is highly recommended for added security.

Inventory:

If the player is 93 or higher hitpoints, blighted anglerfish are superior, cheaper, and have higher utility than the alternative manta rays. Therefore they should be used for higher levelled players. The player can also switch out a protected item for Dinh's bulwark if looking for added survivability.

Players using Tumeken's shadow can get away with wearing defensive ranged items like fortified masori or Armadyl, if they have a high magic accuracy bonus (+100, or higher).

strategy: Bears can be assigned as a slayer task at level 13 combat by various low-level Slayer masters. Bears can be found in various locations throughout Gielinor.

Black bears, bear cubs, grizzly bears, grizzly bear cubs, reanimated bears, Artio, and Callisto can all be killed to satisfy the task. Angry bears (found in Tolna's rift), the Headless Beast (fought during the quest Getting Ahead), and the Crystalline and Corrupted Bear (fought in the Gauntlet and the Corrupted Gauntlet respectively) do not count towards the task.

Those with lower combat levels would find it in their best interest to kill bear cubs, found in the Fremennik Province and throughout Kourend. Black bears would also be a good option, with a combat level of 19. Grizzly bears in most cases are an option if they are close, as most are level 21 combat. The only level 42 combat grizzly bears are found in Tirannwn. Grizzly bear cubs, too, can only be found in Tirannwn, with combat levels ranging from 33 to 36.
summary: A low-level task (13 combat) killed with any style; grizzly bears are the most widespread, black bears are non-aggressive and bear cubs are easiest for low levels. The cluster north-east of Ardougne and the woods outside Rellekka hold the most bears, and the four black bears outside the Mind Altar (between Ice Mountain and Goblin Village) are the biggest black bear group. Krystilia's assignment must be done in the Wilderness, where the bears west of the Graveyard of Shadows are the main option, or Callisto and Artio can be killed for their drops.
usefulItems: Ensouled bear heads with Basic Reanimation (21 Magic) as an easier alternative

strategy: Birds can be assigned as a Slayer task from Turael or Spria. They have no requirements to be assigned and are generally meant as tasks for beginners. There are a wide variety of birds, but the most commonly killed are chickens, seagulls and ducks, which are low-level, rarely deal damage and easy to access. Chickens drop bones, raw chicken and feathers, but most other birds only drop bones or nothing at all, meaning there is little reason to slay higher-level birds.
Birds introduced with the Sailing skill do not reward Slayer experience and thus do not count towards task completion.
summary: A no-requirement beginner task from Turael or Spria. Chickens, seagulls and ducks are the usual targets since they are level 1-3, rarely deal damage and are easy to reach; chickens also drop bones, raw chicken and feathers. Farmer Fred's chicken pen and the Lumbridge farms have the densest chicken spawns. Ducks in water need Ranged or Magic.

strategy: Black demons can be assigned as a Slayer task at 80 combat level by various Slayer masters. They can be found in a variety of dungeons around Gielinor. Black demons can be easily killed using safespots when attacking with Ranged or Magic, or by using melee with the Protect from Melee prayer. They are weak to demonbane weapons, as well as water spells.

For lower-levelled players, black demon tasks can be very daunting, as their high stats requires safespotting, which will significantly lower kill rates. Higher-levelled players will not have this problem, but the demons have a near non-existent drop table which makes killing them generally not worth the time or experience.

The two best spots for killing black demons would be Taverley Dungeon or the Chasm of Fire. The former has many demons packed together while the latter has more safespots, and both are cannonable. The advantage of the latter is that those who have completed A Kingdom Divided and signed a contract with Yama will be able to get contracts from killing the demons. The drop rate is increased when killing them according to preference, but catering to this will prolong tasks and reduce AFK time. While black demons are also found in the Catacombs of Kourend, which is a multicombat area and have access to the catacombs table, it is generally not worth killing them there as they have unusually higher Defence compared to the other variants and it is not possible to utilise all four spawns.
summary: Black demons are killed either by safespotting with Ranged or Magic or by meleeing with Protect from Melee; demonbane weapons and water spells are strong against them. The two best spots are Taverley Dungeon, which packs 24 demons together, and the bottom level of the Chasm of Fire, which has more safespots; both are single-way but cannonable. Their drop table is nearly empty, so lower-levelled players who must safespot often skip the task. Demonic gorillas can be substituted (except on Krystilia or Konar tasks) and are profitable but slower.

trainingSummary.cons: Long task, especially if killing demonic gorillas. Using the cannon will result in a loss.
trainingSummary.pros: Decent experience rates, low-effort task. Demonic gorillas can be killed for good profit at the expense of experience rates.
trainingSummary.recommendation: Block/skip unless killing demonic gorillas for profit/uniques

exampleSetups.label: Brutal black dragon: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
Ranged is typically the best method to kill brutal black dragons, even more so with high-level equipment. The twisted bow offers the highest damage output. Using the dragon hunter crossbow also offers good damage, although much less than the twisted bow. The bow of Faerdhinen with the full crystal armour set will perform slightly better than the best Magic setups, excluding Tumeken's shadow.

Players should wear equipment that maximises Ranged damage, accuracy, and Prayer bonuses. When ranging, players should stand at a distance and use Protect from Magic with an antifire potion active, as this will negate all damage (even without an Anti-dragon shield). Lastly, Rigour, Deadeye, or Eagle Eye should be used for better damage output.

Before entering the brutal black dragon area, drink a dose of divine ranging potion(4) and extended antifire(4), then activate Protect from Magic and Rigour.

Inventory:

- 1 divine ranging potion(4)
- Some food to restore lost health from divine potions
- 2-3 prayer potions
- 1 extended antifire potion, or multiple antifire potions
- Soul bearer to bank ensouled dragon head drops.
- Bonecrusher necklace to swap to before killing the dragons to restore Prayer.
- Nature runes and fire runes for High Level Alchemy, and (optionally) law runes and air runes for Telekinetic Grab to avoid needing to enter melee range for any dragons.
- (Optional) For more Prayer experience but less Prayer point restoration, Sinister Offering can be used instead of the…

exampleSetups.label: Brutal black dragon: Magic
exampleSetups.notes:
Magic can be an effective way to kill brutal black dragons, with good equipment. Tumeken's shadow offers the highest damage output. Using the dragon hunter wand and casting Water Surge also offers good DPS due to the dragon's 50% elemental weakness to water spells. Lesser powered staves, such as the Eye of Ayak, Sanguinesti staff or Trident of the Swamp are generally not worth it, as they are typically outperformed by water spells at a higher cost. Due to their high resistance to magic before the weakness is applied, boosts such as a saturated heart or forgotten brew will still provide a substantial increase in damage from the accuracy boost, despite normally not being very useful on non-powered staves.

Players should wear equipment that maximises Magic damage and accuracy bonuses. When maging, players should stand at a distance and use Protect from Magic with an antifire potion active, as this will negate all damage (even without an anti-dragon shield). Lastly, Augury, Mystic Vigour, or Mystic Might should be used for better damage output.

Inventory:

- A saturated heart or other Magic boosting item. If one is not owned, forgotten brews provide the same boost as an imbued heart, and their downsides can be safely ignored. If none are available, even magic potions are enough of an accuracy boost to be worth bringing.
- Some food in case of mistakes, or if using divine magic potions
- 2-3 prayer potions
- 1 extended antifire potion, or multiple antifire potions
- Bonecrusher…

exampleSetups.label: King Black Dragon: Melee
exampleSetups.notes:
This gear minimises the risk associated with the short trip through the wilderness while optimising DPS. Proselyte can be used for less prayer potion usage and potentially longer trips. The dragon hunter lance scales well with gear upgrades, but the Osmumten's fang can perform better with less equipment strength bonus.

- Notes
- Bring antidote++ and extended antifire potions for poison and dragonfire protection respectively.
- Extended super antifire potions can allow the use of Defenders but you will take more damage overall.
- Bring a right balance of super restore potions and food to sustain for one trip at the King Black Dragon.
- Bring a means of teleporting to the King Black Dragon Lair.
- Bring a teleport to house tablet to teleport out at the end of the trip.

exampleSetups.label: King Black Dragon: Melee Gravestone method
exampleSetups.notes:
This is the best-in-slot available equipment for meleeing the King Black Dragon. It is only worth the time if you plan on spending a lot of time at KBD at once.

- Notes
- While transporting items to the King Black Dragon Lair via the gravestone method, make sure to bring enough food on these trips to be able to sustain for one hour at the King Black Dragon.
- Bring enough super restore potions to be able to sustain for one hour at the King Black Dragon.
- Both the 4-dose antidote++ and extended antifire potions give a total of 48 minutes of protection. Therefore take one sip of each potion at the bank right before starting the actual trip.
- Extended super antifire potions can allow the use of Defenders but you will take more damage overall.
- Bring enough super combat potions to last for one hour.
- Bring a means of teleporting to the King Black Dragon Lair.
- Bring a teleport to house tablet to teleport out at the end of the trip.

exampleSetups.label: King Black Dragon: Twisted Bow / Bowfa
exampleSetups.notes:
This is the recommended equipment for ranging the King Black Dragon without using the gravestone method or taking more than four valuable items. Blessed boots and Blessed coifs are the most expensive items risked and can be downgraded with minimal DPS loss.

- Notes
- Bring antidote++ and extended super antifire (or extended antifire with an anti-dragon shield) potions for poison and dragonfire protection respectively.
- Pray magic instead of melee to reduce dragonfire damage considerably. Swap shield between attacks if using a bow of Faerdhinen while praying melee to reduce damage further, however this risks taking extreme damage if done incorrectly.
- Bring a right balance of super restore potions and food to sustain for one trip at the King Black Dragon.
- Bring a means of teleporting to the King Black Dragon Lair.
- Bring a teleport to house tablet to teleport out at the end of the trip.

exampleSetups.label: King Black Dragon: Crossbow & shield
exampleSetups.notes:
This is the best-in-slot available equipment for ranging the King Black Dragon without using the gravestone method, taking more than four valuable items, or the twisted bow. Utilising a dragonfire ward or anti-dragon shield reduces the amount of damage taken overall when praying protect from melee.

- Notes
- Bring antidote++ and extended antifire potions for poison and dragonfire protection respectively.
- Bring a right balance of super restore potions and food to sustain for one trip at the King Black Dragon.
- Bring a means of teleporting to the King Black Dragon Lair.
- Bring a teleport to house tablet to teleport out at the end of the trip.

exampleSetups.label: King Black Dragon: Gravestone method
exampleSetups.notes:
This is the best-in-slot available equipment for ranging the King Black Dragon. This method takes considerable setup, so only plan on bringing this gear if you intend to stay at KBD for an extended period of time.

- Notes
- If killing the King Black Dragon in a small team or with alt accounts, using the Twisted bow may result in lower kills per hour than a high-end shield setup due to increased occurrence of the Icy Breath attack's freeze effect when not equipped with a form of anti-dragon shield.
- While transporting items to the King Black Dragon Lair via the gravestone method, make sure to bring enough food on these trips to be able to sustain for one hour at the King Black Dragon.
- Bring enough super restore potions to be able to sustain for one hour at the King Black Dragon.
- Both the 4-dose antidote++ and extended antifire potions give a total of 48 minutes of protection. Therefore take one sip of each potion at the bank right before starting the actual trip.
- Bring enough ranging potions to last for one hour.
- Bring a means of teleporting to the King Black Dragon Lair.
- Bring a teleport to house tablet to teleport out at the end of the trip.

exampleSetups.label: King Black Dragon: Dragon Hunter Wand
exampleSetups.notes:
Using the passive damage bonus from the dragon hunter wand, it is possible to outheal the chip damage dealt by the boss and thus the only interaction needed is drinking potions every 5 minutes or so to maintain antifire protection and prayer. This is a very effective method for pet hunting due to the extremely long trip lengths and low interaction requirements, however can be costly due to the high cost of blood barrage. Due to the high cost of items used, it is strongly recommended to use the following method to move gear inside the KBD lair without risking being killed in the Wilderness:

- Enter KBD's lair with no armour equipped, and 4 low value items in inventory. Die to KBD to spawn a gravestone inside the lair.
- Withdraw all gear and potions required, and die a PvM death (e.g. to the Guard (Prifddinas) outside of the Prifddinas house portal with assistance from a locator orb). These items will be added to the gravestone within KBD's lair.
- Return to KBD's lair and withdraw all items from the gravestone.

Pray Protect from Melee and Mystic Might/Mystic Vigour, stay in melee range of the boss and enable auto retaliate, with Blood Barrage autocasting.

- Notes
- It is not recommended to bank most loot from the boss using this method, as this will significantly reduce kills per hour.
- The best method to resupply is to die to the boss, and return to KBD's lair with only potions.

strategy: Bloodvelds are a type of demon that use their long tongues to attack their victims. Being a Slayer monster, bloodvelds require a Slayer level of 50 to be damaged by players. As a demon, it is affected by demonbane weapons. An ash sanctifier may be brought to receive Prayer experience. Bloodvelds are popular among many players for their high Hitpoints and low Defence, thus making them good sources of experience.

Bloodvelds are one of few monsters that attack with magic-based melee, meaning that despite it using melee attacks against the player, it is the player's magic defence (rather than their melee defence) that is used to determine the accuracy of the bloodveld's attack. As such, it is recommended for players killing bloodvelds to equip armour with decent magic defence, such as dragonhide or blood moon armour, as they are relatively accurate in combat. Players using Prayer should still pray Protect from Melee instead of magic to nullify damage.

There are many locations to kill bloodvelds, though the most common one is the Stronghold Slayer Cave, due to its close proximity to a bank. The bloodvelds can also be killed here with a dwarf multicannon, requiring relatively low attention. The Meiyerditch Laboratories are notably multi-combat and cannonable. It is not recommended to kill bloodvelds elsewhere, as they take longer to access and/or are not cannonable. Bloodvelds have a superior variant, the insatiable bloodveld, if the perk Bigger and Badder is active.
summary: Bloodvelds have high Hitpoints and low Defence and attack with magic-based melee, so wear armour with good magic defence such as dragonhide and pray Protect from Melee if using prayer. The Meiyerditch Laboratories are the best spot because they are multicombat and cannonable with a cluster of seven mutated bloodvelds, giving the most experience per hour; the Stronghold Slayer Cave is the common choice for its bank proximity and cannon use. The God Wars Dungeon and Wilderness God Wars Dungeon locations are recommended to skip.

trainingSummary.pros: Good experience rates when cannoning mutated bloodvelds in the Meiyerditch Laboratories or Buccaneers' Laboratory. Drops cover some of the cost of using the cannon if in Meiyerditch Laboratories.

strategy: Blue dragons can be assigned as a Slayer task at level 65 combat by mid- and high-level Slayer masters after starting Dragon Slayer I. They can be found in various caves across Gielinor, with most of them having some requirement to access, such as completion of quests, a dusty key, or level 70 Agility.

Blue dragons attack using melee, as well as dragonfire, for which some form of dragonfire protection should be considered. Additionally, brutal blue dragons can also attack with magic. Due to their large size, blue dragons can usually be safespotted with ranged, magic, or halberd-like weapons. Like all dragons, they are also susceptible to dragonbane weapons.

When assigned a general task of blue dragons, players who seek a fast task are recommended to bring a dwarf multicannon to Taverley Dungeon, using it against the baby blue dragons in the main dungeon, as the task-only area is full of adults. Players who want slightly more profit are recommended to kill the adult dragons. If players want the maximum profit from the task, it is highly recommended to complete Dragon Slayer II in order to access Vorkath, who has very consistent and valuable commons.
summary: Blue dragons use melee and short-range dragonfire, so bring an anti-dragon shield or antifire and pray Protect from Melee, or safespot them with Ranged, Magic or a halberd since they are large. For a fast task, take a dwarf multicannon to the main Taverley Dungeon and cannon the baby blue dragons; adults give more profit. Skip Konar tasks to the Ogre Enclave, Catacombs or Ruins of Tapoyauik (no cannon or spread-out dragons); Vorkath after Dragon Slayer II is the most profitable alternative.

strategy: Brine rats are Slayer monsters that can be found in the Brine Rat Cavern near Rellekka. They are notable for being the only monsters to drop the brine sabre. A Slayer level of 47 is required to fight them.

They are only assigned to players who have completed Olaf's Quest. Additionally, they can be killed as an alternative for a rat Slayer task provided the player has the appropriate Slayer level to do so.
Killing a brine rat is a requirement for completing the medium task set in the Fremennik Diary.
Brine rats have relatively low Defence, but fairly high Strength and Attack. As such, it is recommended to bring food if players do not have high (~70) Defence.

Players may instead opt to bring a number of Bones to Peaches tablets to convert their bones drops to peaches, which heal 8 hitpoints each. Bringing logs and a tinderbox to cook and eat the raw rat meat and occasional drops of raw swordfish and raw shark, may also be done, though this is significantly more time-consuming and less efficient than using peaches. Alternatively, Olaf, outside the caverns, has a permanent fire located beside him, so players may cook any unnoted food drops on his fire if they are willing to exit and re-enter the caverns. A fish barrel can be used to store the unnoted raw fish, though these drops are infrequent.

There are two safespots, one being the black bones to the south-east, and the other in the north-west corner of the cave. If the brine rats are in the north half of the cave, you are able to safespot them from behind the bones in the corner.
Click here for a picture guide of the safe spots.

Rat bone weapons can be used to kill brine rats and have an added 10 hitpoints of damage added to the player's max hit, making these weapons incredibly effective compared to other weapons with similar stats. Even compared to the highest tier weapons, rat bone weapons might still be more effective depending on your stats and boosts, as the difference in max hit based on other weapon's strength bonuses might not be enough to reach 10 hitpoints of extra damage towards their max hit.
summary: Brine rats live only in the Brine Rat Cavern near Rellekka, entered by digging with a spade south of the windswept tree (fairy ring DKS is right beside it). They have low Defence but fairly high Attack and Strength, so bring food unless your Defence is around 70; two safespots exist behind the bones in the south-east and north-west corners. Rat bone weapons add 10 to your max hit against them. The cavern is single-way but a cannon can be used.

exampleSetups.label: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
Callisto has very low defence against ranged, and is particularly dangerous when up close. The ideal setup is 3-4 items to maximize ranged strength and accuracy, along with magical defence and tank equipment, such as a Dinh's bulwark, for PK'ers. In a team, consider having 1 group member equipped with a charged tome of water and runes to cast vulnerability to reduce Callisto's defence by 15% on a successful hit, increasing the group's DPS by around 5-7% depending on gear.

Webweaver is the strongest weapon against Artio. Ideally you want to maximize range damage, while keeping your magic attack bonus at 0 or higher to allow for guaranteed freezes on Artio. Gear like bloodbark boots, barrows gloves, imbued god capes, god books and ring of shadows are good to keep your magic bonus high enough, without sacrificing much range dps or incurring high risk. Defence bonus -- particularly magic defence -- is also beneficial for tanking PKers.
