strategy: Mogres are Slayer monsters and a type of ogre that are found in Mudskipper Point, requiring level 32 Slayer to kill. Mogres appear when disturbed by the player, who must lure them using Fishing explosives on an Ominous Fishing Spot. Previously, they could only be killed by players who had completed the Skippy and the Mogres miniquest. Since the release of Sailing, Mogres swimming in the ocean can now be killed with cannons from the player's boat. Doing so does not require completion of Skippy and the Mogres and does not demand the use of Fishing explosives, but still requires having level 32 Slayer.

Mogres can only be "lured" by clicking Use on the fishing explosives in your inventory, then clicking on the ominous fishing spots while also standing a few tiles away. Although the ominous fishing spots do have an options to "Lure" or "Bait", both these options do nothing (even with fishing explosives) and instead merely say in chat "Something seems to have scared all the fishes away..."
Mogres are usually killed by players searching for their unique drops of flippers or Mudskipper hats.

Mogres can be safespotted by using the fairy ring, the STASH unit to the west, or along the shoreline. A tinderbox and logs can be brought to make fires, as mogres often drop raw fish. There is also an altar in Rimmington church just to the north of Mudskipper Point to restore prayer if using Protect from Melee.
summary: Mogres are a level 32 Slayer ogre-type monster assigned by Mazchna and Vannaka; there is no dedicated task page, the Slayer task list links Mogres to Slayer task/Ogres and mogres also count for an Ogres task. On land they live only at Mudskipper Point (fairy ring AIQ), where you must Use a fishing explosive on an Ominous Fishing Spot from a few tiles away to lure one ashore; they can be safespotted from the fairy ring, the STASH unit to the west or along the shoreline, and the Rimmington church altar just north restores prayer for Protect from Melee. Since Sailing, swimming mogres in the Ardent Ocean can be killed with a ship cannon without explosives or the miniquest, but 32 Slayer is still required. Bring a tinderbox and logs to cook the raw fish they drop.

Maniacal monkeys have a Magic defence of 1 and so increasing magical accuracy will increase hit accuracy by no more than 1%. Therefore, the objective is to increase the max hit of the spell with the largest magic damage bonus.

The base hit of Ice Burst is 22. The maximum hit with all magic damage bonuses is 33.

Items to bring for Ice Bursting are prioritised as follows:

- Equipment that increases max hit
- Equipment that increases prayer bonus

Players who have completed the Morytania Hard Diary also have the option of using a Bonecrusher necklace to completely remove the need to pick up prayer potions. This option is not fully AFK, however, as NPC aggression must be reset every 10 minutes.

exampleSetups.label: Maniacal monkey: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
Prayer bonus vs Ranged attack bonus:

Maniacal monkeys have a Defence level of 10. Because of this, equipping best-in-slot ranged accuracy gear versus no items at a Ranged level of 80/99 will only increase accuracy by 0.75%/0.60%. In the worst case scenario, this translates to a negligible 14 missed hits per hour.

Because of this, prioritising prayer bonus over ranged accuracy results in 23-42 fewer prayer potions doses per hour or less time spent without a necklace of anguish or rupture equipped if using the bonecrusher method. If you instead use max ranged bonus gear and are able to pick up prayer potions and continue throwing chinchompas without losing any ticks or unstacking the monkeys significantly, you would gain no more than an extra 5,000 experience per hour. It is much more likely that players will spend more time picking up and consuming prayer potions than the minimal extra damage output of ranged accuracy gear. For this reason prayer bonus gear is considered superior to having higher ranged accuracy, and it also makes training less intense.

The lone exception to this may occur at certain ranged levels and with certain setups (DPS calculation required) when the player does not gain a max hit from wearing the necklace of anguish or rupture. In this specific case, wearing the bonecrusher necklace with a preference for high ranged accuracy equipment over prayer bonus (ex: pegasian boots, archers ring (i)) becomes slightly better, as your prayer will remain almost…

exampleSetups.label: Bryophyta: Killing Bryophyta
exampleSetups.notes:
With decent combat stats, one can expect to do 4–7 Bryophyta kills per trip. Equip full rune armour or green d'hide armour and a rune scimitar, and fill your inventory with swordfish (optionally, bring one strength potion and some anchovy pizza). When the growthlings appear, take a bronze axe from the logs in the lair (when required, juggle some food for inventory space). Be conservative with defensive prayers (Protect from Magic) to increase trip length, and optionally flick offensive prayers (Incredible Reflexes and/or Ultimate Strength).

Note: When not using a slash weapon such as rune scimitar, one requires a knife or bronze axe or similar to slash a web before accessing the lair.

exampleSetups.label: Moss giant: Obtaining keys
exampleSetups.notes:
Bryophyta requires one mossy key to permanently gain access to her lair and subsequent keys can be used to open a chest within. These keys can be most quickly obtained by killing Bryophyta herself, as each kill has a droprate of 1/16, since keys are no longer required to access her lair after being unlocked once.

Alternatively, keys can be acquired in free-to-play by killing moss giants in the Wilderness, as these have a 1/100 drop chance as opposed to 1/150 for all other moss giants. Bring as little risk as possible, and be prepared for player killers. An example setup is shown on the right, which includes some runes for High Level Alchemy (requires ), and Snare to evade player killers (requires ). Do not use Prayer except against player killers.

The moss giants can easily be reached from Ferox Enclave using the canoe (requires ) or by using the minigame teleport to last man standing. One should expect 1-3 keys and a beginner clue per trip. One should leave when a player killer starts attacking them or when one has less than 10 swordfish left. Try to walk back to Ferox Enclave, or further towards Grand Exchange when teleblocked (and then take the canoe to Ferox Enclave).

The profit calculation does not take any loot other than keys into account from these moss giants. Picking up some loot will increase profit somewhat.

If a player killer is about to kill you it's best to drop the keys. They are untradeable and won't appear for other players. After you've been killed you…

Moss giants are located across Gielinor and most of these locations have safespots. Moss giants have zero defence against every attack style and are 50% weak to fire damage. Varrock Sewers is a strong pick because it is multicombat, cannonable, safespottable and right next to Bryophyta's lair; Catacombs of Kourend giants also drop dark totem pieces but no cannon is allowed there. Krystilia tasks must be done at the Wilderness Pond (level 35), which has a safespot for one spawn.

strategy: Nechryael are a type of demon that can be assigned as a slayer task at level 80 Slayer and 85 combat by various Slayer masters. They are notable for their frequent drops of herbs, seeds, and alchable items, making them an extremely good slayer task.

Nechryael attack with melee, and can periodically summon up to two death spawns to assist them in battle. These death spawns are fairly inaccurate with a max hit of 2, but as they attack with typeless melee, Protect from Melee has no effect on them. Uniquely, they are able to attack you in single-combat areas regardless of if you are already in combat. It is recommended to bring food if using Melee or to have runes to cast blood spells if using Magic to kill nechryaels. It is also possible to leave the area and return to lose aggression, but this is impractical in most situations.

A stronger variant of the Nechryael, the Greater Nechryael, can be found in the Catacombs of Kourend, Iorwerth Dungeon and Wilderness Slayer Cave. These are mechanically the same as their standard counterparts, barring higher stats. It is highly recommended to kill these whenever possible, as they have a more lucrative drop table. Both variants share the same superior, the Nechryarch, though the common drop table takes from whichever variant they came from. Nechryarch attack with melee, but will periodically summon a trio of chaotic death spawn; one each in melee, magic and ranged. They hit significantly harder, but their attacks can be blocked with prayer. These spawns will only appear if the Nechryarch is allowed to attack the player, so using safespots or farcasting will prevent this from happening.
summary: Nechryael (80 Slayer, 85 combat, Priest in Peril to be assigned) are melee demons that summon up to two death spawns whose typeless hits ignore Protect from Melee and single-combat rules, so bring food or use blood spells. The wiki's fastest option is bursting or barraging the 14 greater nechryael in the Catacombs of Kourend with a goading potion to draw aggression, since they are not aggressive; for melee it recommends the Iorwerth Dungeon (the nechryael there drop crystal shards) with a demonbane weapon such as Emberlight or Arclight. Normal nechryael in the Slayer Tower are safespottable using the tables and buckets, and the Charred Dungeon (60 Sailing) is a multicombat, cannonable spot for normal nechryael. Krystilia tasks must be done in the task-only Wilderness Slayer Cave; bring a one-click teleport such as a royal seed pod.

Along with ogres and ogress warriors and shamans, mogres, zogres, and skogres can be killed to satisfy the task. Jogres do not count towards the task.

The wiki says the best place is directly west of Yanille, where you can stand between the plants and the dry stone walls so the ogres can never reach you; the Chaos Druid Tower dungeon (46 Thieving) is a quiet alternative and the caged ogres at the Combat Training Camp (Biohazard) can be ranged or maged with no danger. strategy: Otherworldly beings are unusual Zanarian monsters. They are commonly assigned as Slayer tasks by Vannaka. They are found south of the bank in Zanaris and can be safespotted by standing next to the flower pond and attacking the ones on the other side, however they move around quite a lot and players may find them difficult to safespot. An alternate and more consistent safespotting method is standing on the north or south of the pond and corner trapping the mobs on the pond corners.

More specifically, five of the six otherworldly beings have a wander radius which permits safespotting without having them retreat as long as the player stands right next to the pond. One of these five will retreat if attacked horizontally across the pond, and another will retreat when attacked vertically. The other three will not retreat as long as you stay next to the pond.
Otherworldly beings may be a decent source of Magic experience, herbs, runes, and the materials for rings of forging for Ironmen.
summary: Otherworldly beings are level 64 spectral monsters found only south of the bank in Zanaris, assigned by Vannaka at 40 combat after Lost City. They are not aggressive and can be safespotted by standing next to the flower pond and attacking across it, or more reliably by corner-trapping them at the pond corners; they wander a lot, so a couple will retreat if attacked across the pond. They are a decent source of herbs, runes and ring-of-forging materials for ironmen, and an Ectoplasmator gives Prayer XP because they are spectral.
usefulItems: Ranged or Magic for the pond safespot

exampleSetups.label: Magic & Ranged
exampleSetups.notes: Muspah is most effectively fought with Magic and Ranged. Magic should be used on Muspah's Melee form, and Ranged should be used otherwise. Using sapphire bolts (e) with a crossbow is strongly recommended on Muspah's prayer shield, ideally in combination with Smite and Greater Corruption.

exampleSetups.label: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
Ranged only setups are sometimes preferred for simplicity, especially if players aren't as comfortable with a large amount of equipment swaps.

Upon entering the boss arena, if Muspah spawns in Melee form, it may save time to leave and re-enter to spend more time overall hitting Muspah's ranged form, which has lower ranged defence. Alternatively, with a Zaryte crossbow, using a special attack with Ruby bolts (e) special on the first Melee phase can be beneficial.

Alternatively, some players prefer to use a Elder maul, Dragon warhammer, or Tonalztics of Ralos special attack to reduce Muspah's defence and speed up kill times.

exampleSetups.label: Melee
exampleSetups.notes:
Assuming a successful defence-reducing special attack has landed, a Scythe of Vitur can provide comparable damage to best-in-slot Ranged and Magic options. However, the reliance on this can make it a less effective option, and a ranged swap is still strongly recommended for Muspah's prayer shield and during the teleportation phase.

Mastering the step-back method in Muspah's melee phase is functionally required for this method.

strategy: The Phantom Muspah is a solo boss that can be fought after completion of the quest Secrets of the North. It is the leftover energy of the Strange Creature that manifested after the events of the quest.

The Phantom Muspah is stronger than its quest variant, but otherwise shares the same attacks and mechanics. All forms of the Phantom Muspah have 33% freeze resistance, meaning it will only stay frozen for 66% of the base freeze duration.

Unique drops from the boss include ancient essence, used in the creation of forgotten brews or upgrading the imbued heart into a saturated heart, and the venator shard, of which five can be combined to create the venator bow, a unique bow that shines in multicombat situations.
summary: The Phantom Muspah is a level 741 solo instanced boss in its lair off the Ghorrock Dungeon beneath Weiss, unlocked by completing Secrets of the North, and can be assigned as a boss task by Konar, Nieve and Duradel.

exampleSetups.label: Zombie pirate: Gear setup
exampleSetups.notes:
Upon arriving, placing the cannon and disposing of burning amulet will open 5 inventory slots to alchemize loot. All other unstackable loot can be added to a closed looting bag. The druids commonly drop herbs, so it is recommended to also bring an herb sack. Air and law runes are useful for casting telekinetic grab to save time collecting loot, and can also double as a Camelot teleport for banking.

A venator bow works especially well in this area due to its low risk and ability to hit multiple targets.

Dying with this setup costs around in total: to repair the Elite Void Knight equipment, to re-obtain the rune pouch, and approximately to replace lost supplies. The herb sack and salve amulet(ei) will go to a gravestone with no fee, but its contents will be granted to the player killer. Running further north past level 20 Wilderness is not advised, as the player would lose unprotected and non-locked items or pay a large fee for locked items.

Locking a rune pouch with a trouver parchment is highly recommended, as a regular (non-locked) rune pouch is always lost on death to a player, even below level 20 Wilderness.

A large portion of risk (from 2.5m down to about 1m) can be mitigated by not bringing a locked rune pouch at the expense of 3 inventory slots. In that case it is advised to bank more frequently. The blessed Dizana's quiver and venator ring can also be downgraded to an assembler and ring of the gods (i), although both items will be protected upon death regardless.…
exampleSetups.source: Money making guide/Killing zombie pirates (Max efficiency)

exampleSetups.label: Zombie pirate: Strategy
exampleSetups.notes:
A burning amulet can be used to quickly reach the Chaos Temple, though running east from Ferox Enclave is also a good option. Due to the dangerous nature of the area, shorter trips and frequent banking are advised. Pray Protect from Magic at all times to avoid taking damage from the chaos druids. Restocking frequently, every 20 minutes or so, will minimise risk.

Having used the Teleport anchoring scroll is recommended as this prevents the player from getting teleported around by the chaos druids that also attack. The scrolls effects are permanent.

Players who have completed Slug Menace may consider replacing Monk's robes with Proselyte armour (or Initiate armour after Recruitment drive) for increased Prayer and crush defensive bonuses, though its negative magic defensive bonuses will result in faster deaths to PKers. A full set can be obtained for only. A mitre is also an inexpensive way to increase Prayer bonus.

Standing outside the walls of the temple is recommended if using potions to restore prayer, since zombies are more densely packed outside, and it allows for an easier escape over the bridge to the south. If standing by the altar for free prayer restoration, plan to escape northward.

In the event of an attack by PKers, choose an escape route (teleporting is not an option):

- Directly south, over the bridge towards the Wilderness ditch (recommended).
- North then south-east to cross the stepping stone shortcut (requiring level 72 Agility) if you are situated at…

requiredItems: Lockpick (Pirates' Hideout only)
strategy: Pirates can be assigned as a Slayer task from Krystilia.

Pirates can be found at level 55 Wilderness in the Pirates' Hideout. A lockpick is required to enter. They are combat level 26 and have a very minimal droptable. They are located in single-way combat.

Alternatively, Zombie pirate can be killed. They are combat levels 22, 28, and 34 located at the Chaos Temple. It is located in multi-way combat and a cannon can be used. Nearby Elder Chaos druids will consistently teleblock the player and Protect from Magic is highly recommended. There is a nearby altar to recharge prayer. Zombie pirates have a generous drop table making them a popular monster to kill. It is recommended to complete the medium Wilderness Diary which increases the drop table roll from 15% to 50%.
summary: Pirates are a Krystilia-only Wilderness task (39 Thieving) with two options. The level 26 pirates in the Pirates' Hideout at level 54-55 Wilderness need a lockpick to enter, are in single-way combat and have a minimal drop table. The wiki favours the level 22-34 zombie pirates at the Chaos Temple in level 11 Wilderness, which is multicombat, cannonable and gives a generous drop table (much better with the medium Wilderness diary), but nearby elder chaos druids will teleblock you, so use Protect from Magic and recharge at the temple altar.

strategy: Rats can be assigned as a slayer task from Turael and Spria. They have no requirements to be assigned. There are a wide variety of rats that can count toward the task, but the most commonly killed are rats and giant rats, which are low-level, rarely deal damage, and practically ubiquitous. It is recommended to use Rat bone weapons as it has greatly increased effectiveness against rats.

Scurrius can be fought for greater experience and profit, although his minions will also decrement the task, reducing how many times the boss can be fought on task. Brine rats are accessible during Olaf's Quest, and drop medium clues and the elusive brine sabre.

Hell-rat behemoths can be accessed after Freeing Evil Dave, and drop full spice shakers for spicy stews. Crypt rat and giant crypt rat variations require completion of Priest in Peril for access to Morytania and may be slain by players for the higher Slayer experience reward or for changing their reward potential inside the Barrows minigame.

exampleSetups.label: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes: This setup aims to maximise DPS against the revenants while miminizing risk. Ranged can usually offer better dps against revenants with less gear used, and d'hide conveniently adds ranged accuracy while giving magic defence. However, you will be more vulnerable to incoming melee and ranged attacks from PKers without a shield.

exampleSetups.label: Melee
exampleSetups.notes: Melee is generally less damage than ranged setups, but is tankier against revenants and PKers. You gain additional defence and utility from melee gear such as the serpentine helm and dragonfire shield.

exampleSetups.label: Mage
exampleSetups.notes: Mage is not commonly used due to its average dps and poor defensive bonuses. However, the accursed sceptre will perform better than most other ranged or melee setups without their respective Wilderness weapons.

exampleSetups.label: Survivability
exampleSetups.notes:
This setup uses a ranged tank setup which aims to prioritise survivability with slightly increased risk, while maintaining high dps. This is achieved via a clever use of protected items with the most benefit, alongside cheap gear that provides a lot of defensive stats. This setup is mostly for higher levels with more to spend, but will work for anybody with high hitpoints and relatively high defence and magic levels. The risk is still extremely low due to the low cost of the tank items and the high chance of surviving.

Use the agility shortcuts and prioritise teleporting. If teleblocked, focus on running and eating. Ignore prayer switches but keep prayer points topped up. Summer pies can help reach the level requirement for the agility shortcuts.

To get there, teleport using the Revenant cave teleport scroll which leads to Revenant dragons. Ensure you have ether in your Bracelet of ethereum and have it toggled to collect ether.

- Never skull, use skull prevention.
- Always use Protect from Magic and Protect item. Switch from offensive ranged prayers to Augury when attacked. This is to avoid a full teleblock. You can survive a half teleblock quite easily even from somebody in max. It's also because the build is centred around providing bulk against melee/ranged so camping Protect from Magic and Augury prevents spells from landing.
- When attacked, switch to the tank legs, phoenix necklace and Dinh's bulwark. Often pkers will give up at this point.
- Check that you are…

locations.notes: Three one-way entrances: level 17 (east of Dark Warriors' Fortress), level 26 (north of Bandit Camp) and level 40 (south-east of Lava Maze); Revenant cave teleport goes to the level 40 entrance. Singles-plus: another player can attack you while you fight a revenant. Agility shortcuts at 65/75/89. The Revenants page itself gives the revenants' range as 'levels 19 to 40' and Krystilia's table lists 19-38; the 17-40 range is the whole cave (Revenant Caves page).
requirements: 100,000 coin entry fee (repaid only if you die)

strategy: Revenants are the ghostly versions of creatures slain during the God Wars found in the Revenant Caves within the Wilderness in levels 19 to 40. They are capable of hitting high and accurately for their combat levels, although most of the damage can be mitigated with a charged bracelet of ethereum. As the Revenant Caves location is members-only, all revenants are members-only creatures.

Revenants have a fairly generous drop table, but as they are in the Wilderness, the player is always at risk of getting killed by other players. Due to the revenants' lucrativeness, player killers are common. The caves they inhabit are singles-plus combat, where PvP situations take priority over PvM: a player in combat with a revenant can be attacked by another player.

Unique drops from the revenants include the Wilderness weapons, a set of weapons that have increased effectiveness against monsters in the Wilderness when charged with revenant ether. They also drop various ancient artefacts, which can be sold to the Emblem Trader wandering within the Revenant Caves for a set amount of coins, as well as ancient crystals, four of which are used to construct an obelisk in the superior garden of a player-owned house.

Revenants are capable of using all three forms of combat. Their attacks have very high accuracy against any player not using a bracelet of ethereum regardless of their defensive bonuses. In addition, their attacks change based on the player's defensive stats and protection prayers being used. They are also capable of healing themselves when their health falls below 50%, though this only occurs a limited amount of times. When it heals itself, a lightning strike can be seen.
Being undead, revenants are susceptible to the effects of the salve amulet and its enchanted version.
summary: A Krystilia-only Wilderness task done in the Revenant Caves, usually with Ranged (Craw's or Webweaver bow) while wearing a charged bracelet of ethereum, which cuts revenant damage by 75% and removes their aggression. Pray Protect from Magic and Protect Item, since magic is their most accurate style. Revenants are undead, so a salve amulet or amulet of avarice boosts damage, and Wilderness weapon drop rates are 5x while on a Krystilia task.

exampleSetups.label: Melee (Low level)
exampleSetups.notes:
As Sarachnis is weak to crush and has high magic and ranged defence, melee crush is the most viable method of killing her. Magic defence is prioritised due to two magic-using spawns that will appear during the fight. Aranea boots allow the player to avoid Sarachnis' web attack, but their cost may be prohibitive for lower level players. Without their use, it is beneficial to be prepared to swap to Protect from Missiles during the fight when outside of her melee range.

Inventory:

- Special attack weapon, such as Burning claws
- 1-2 Super combat potions
- 4-6 Prayer potions or super restores
- Teleport such as Xeric's talisman, House tablets, or Book of the Dead to reach the Forthos Dungeon
- Slash weapon to cut through webs, such as a Wilderness sword 1, unless wearing the aranea boots.
- House tablets or Ring of dueling for a one click teleport, stat restoration and access to a bank
- Book of the Dead for casting resurrection spells on the Arceuus spellbook
- Rune pouch with runes for Resurrect Greater Ghost
- The rest Cooked karambwans or better

Optionally:

- Death runes and Soul runes for Death Charge for more special attacks

Note: Players using Aranea boots do not need to bring a slash weapon for webs

exampleSetups.label: Melee (High level)
exampleSetups.notes:
As Sarachnis is weak to crush and has high magic and ranged defence, melee crush is the most viable method of killing her. Magic defence is prioritised due to two magic-using spawns that will appear during the fight. It is highly recommended to bring aranea boots, as their unique mechanic will always free the player from Sarachnis' web attack, speeding up and simplifying the fight and negating the need to change prayer.

Inventory:

- Special attack weapon, such as Dragon claws
- 1-2 Divine super combat potions
- Saturated heart for magic defence
- 6-12 Prayer potions or super restores
- Sharks or higher tier food for remaining inventory space
- Book of the Dead for casting resurrection spells on the Arceuus spellbook
- Divine rune pouch with runes for thralls and Death Charge
- Teleport such as Xeric's talisman, House tablets, or Book of the Dead to reach the Forthos Dungeon
- House tablets for stat restoration and access to a bank

Tumeken's shadow's high accuracy and damage make it uniquely effective against Sarachnis when used with high-level magic equipment, although poor special attack weapons and lower melee defence lead to melee setups generally performing better overall.

While using Protect from Missiles and standing by the empty sarcophagus at the eastern side of the lair, the player will occasionally be out of the melee spawns' aggression range and outside of Sarachnis' melee range, and able to reach Sarachnis no matter where she is, negating the need for aranea boots.

Inventory:

- Saturated heart

- Divine rune pouch with runes for thralls

Scorpions have very limited drop tables, usually only dropping ensouled scorpion heads and beginner clue scrolls.

exampleSetups.label: Melee
exampleSetups.notes:
Since the Shellbane Gryphon's knockback is effective against players with less than 40 kg of worn equipment, some of the best options do not necessarily provide the highest damage, but rather a balance between strength bonus and heavy weight.

A 40kg+ setup can be easily achieved with most melee armour coupled with both a tortugan and dragonfire shield, even when using a slayer helmet. If a black mask is used, its higher weight over the slayer helmet means that the player can slot in an avernic defender for better DPS. If not being used, the dragonfire shield is recommended to meet this requirement.

If using low-level gear, adamant armour may be preferred to rune as it is heavier.

Inventory:

- Special attack weapon such as a dragon dagger. If using the Arkan blade as a main-hand damaging weapon, its special attack will suffice.
- Divine super combat potions / super combat potions; or super attack potions + super strength potions if those are not available.
- Means to teleport to house, such as Teleport to house (tablet) or Construction cape
- Rune pouch, with runes to cast Resurrection spells and a Book of the Dead.
- If A Kingdom Divided has not yet been completed, simply bring nature runes and fire runes for High Level Alchemy.
- Explorer's ring 4 if high alching runite item drops and using the Arceuus Spellbook.
- Herb sack if collecting herb drops.
- Bonecrusher or bonecrusher necklace for Prayer experience and to reduce number of items on ground.
- A bracelet of…

exampleSetups.label: Melee (POH)
exampleSetups.notes:
Due to Shellbane gryphon's cave's proximity to fairy ring, players who have ornate rejuvenation pool and fairy ring built in their player-owned house can teleport out between kills and restore their hitpoints, special attack, and prayer points. This has three major benefits:

- Less supplies used
- Allows special attacks to be used more often
- Allows player to bring better equipment
- The weight aspect of gryphon's knockback can be ignored, since it's unlikely that the gryphon will do that more than once per kill and the damage taken is only moderate.

~50-65 kills per hour can be achieved with this method, depending on what gear player has access to, and how attentively they are playing.

Inventory:

- Special attack weapon
- Tortugan shield
- Divine super combat potions / super combat potions
- Surge potions to get an extra spec every kill, the cooldown gets reset when you use your POH pool
- Means to teleport to house, such as Teleport to house (tablet) or Construction cape
- Rune pouch
- Book of the Dead if using thralls instead of Vengeance
- Explorer's ring 4 if high alching rune drops
- Bonecrusher for passive prayer experience

strategy: Skeletal wyverns are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 72 in order to be harmed. They are found at the end of the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon. There is a shortcut at the ladder to the Ice Dungeon leading to the skeletal wyverns requiring level 82 Agility (or level 77 Agility with a Summer pie). Like other wyverns, they require an elemental shield, mind shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield to reduce damage from their icy breath; however, it is not required to be slain. They are also the only monster that drop granite legs.

Although Tarn in his diary writes that he believes skeletal wyverns are undead, they are actually magically animated remains, different from actual undead creatures. This means that the Salve amulet and its enchanted versions do not work against them. They originate from Fossil Island, having escaped the island via magic. Additionally, their bones radiate a very weak magical aura, and stay colder than room temperature.

Skeletal wyverns are assigned by the Slayer masters Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve, and Duradel/Kuradal. Because an elemental shield or better is required to defend against their icy breath, they will only assign them if the player has completed the Elemental Workshop I quest.
summary: A 72 Slayer task from Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve and Duradel done at the end of the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, where an elemental, mind, dragonfire or ancient wyvern shield cuts their icy breath from 50+ to 10. They are draconic, so a dragon hunter lance (pound/swipe) or dragon hunter crossbow is best; pray Protect from Melee in melee range or Protect from Missiles otherwise, and a cannon is allowed in the lower cave. Many players safespot them with a crossbow after they lose aggression, using the cave door or a tile north-west of Steve; a task-only upper area exists but is a no-cannon zone.

exampleSetups.label: Vet'ion: Equipment
exampleSetups.notes:
Always keep risk to a minimum in the Wilderness! - Whenever gearing, check your Items Kept on Death and enable "Wilderness beyond level 20" to make sure important items will not be lost.

The most effective equipment to fight Vet'ion involves a large amount of risk by using items that can be protected with Trouver parchments, but most players should opt for cheaper setups until they are confident in their ability to handle PKers. The Ursine chainmace is by far the most effective weapon against Vet'ion, but comes with additional risk as it must be charged with Revenant ether. Players should choose three (or four, with Protect item if you are confident you can mitigate the risk of being Smited) valuable with the most strength bonus possible compared to cheaper alternatives.

Note: The benefit from Salve amulet (e) does not stack with a Slayer helmet. As Salve amulets are free and kept on death below Level 20 Wilderness they should always be prioritised.

Example setup:

The aim is to maximise damage output while minimising risk. Choosing three items with a large amount of melee strength bonus is recommended, such as
the ultor ring or the avernic defender, and using cheap items otherwise which can be easily replaced such as barrows gloves, Salve amulet (e), and the helm of Neitiznot.

If on a skeleton or boss task, the player can use bracelet of slaughter to extend the task. This will affect damage output, but lower the player's risk slightly.

- Looting bag (strongly recommended, can also be obtained from Vet'ion or his summons)
- Some form of antipoison e.g. Sanfew serums (optional, recommended, if poisoned/venomed by a PKer or inside the escape caves)
- Rest food — Blighted manta ray or blighted anglerfish at 93+ (optional: 2+ Blighted karambwan for combo-eating)
- Stamina potion, Guthix rest (+5% energy per dose), summer pies (+10% energy per half) for escaping PKers —

For more advanced setups, if players are confident in their ability to tank PKers to safety and are comfortable risking more and/or staying longer, an inventory could look more like the second example. None of these are required for the boss fight and may add some risk, but can be worthwhile additions for players barely failing to escape.

- Dinh's bulwark switch — greatly increase survivability against multiple attackers

strategy: Skeletons are undead monsters that can be assigned as tasks at combat level 15 by various low-level Slayer masters. They are often found in cemeteries and dungeons. A good strategy to kill them is to use melee with a weapon with crush bonuses (such as a Viggora's chainmace) and a salve amulet or salve amulet (e), due to their low crush defence.
Another strategy to kill them would be with magic. Many skeletons have an elemental weakness to earth spells, making those a very effective option.

Players who seek a greater challenge can choose to kill Vet'ion or Calvar'ion. These bosses are significantly stronger than the typical skeleton, but provide plenty of rewards for players who seek to kill them. In order to access Calvar'ion, the player must have completed the Hard Wilderness Diary. Vet'ion only requires completing the Medium Wilderness Diary, but is deeper in the Wilderness and resides in a multicombat area. Accessing the bosses requires a one-time payment of coins, which must be repaid again if the player dies to another player in the Wilderness. Note that the skeletal hellhounds they summon also count towards the task, so every kill at the boss is equal to five skeletons per spawn.
summary: A beginner task from Turael, Spria and Mazchna (or Krystilia in the Wilderness) against undead skeletons, best killed with a crush weapon and a salve amulet because of their low crush defence, or with earth spells which exploit their elemental weakness. The Edgeville Dungeon has a good cluster that can be cannoned with a quick escape; the Catacombs of Kourend are multicombat with bonus shard and totem drops. Krystilia's version can be done in the Wilderness part of Edgeville Dungeon, the Wilderness mines, or by killing Vet'ion or Calvar'ion.

locations.name: Smoke Devil Dungeon
locations.notes: Only location; 30 smoke devils in the main room and 6 in the boss room, none safespottable. Fairy ring BKP or a ring of dueling to Castle Wars then run south-west. Place the cannon in the centre and stack the devils behind the remains; the cannon is destroyed if set up in the boss room.
requirements: Active smoke devil (or Thermonuclear smoke devil) task

requiredItems: Facemask or Slayer helmet
strategy: Smoke devils can be assigned as a slayer task at level 93 Slayer and level 85 combat by high-end Slayer masters. They are only found in the Smoke Devil Dungeon south of Castle Wars and can only be fought if on a task. They attack with magical ranged. As with dust devils, players must wear a facemask or slayer helm when fighting smoke devils, or their attacks will always deal moderate damage that also drains stats.
Players may choose between killing smoke devils or their boss variant, the thermonuclear smoke devil.

When killing normal smoke devils, players are highly encouraged to use barrage spells, as smoke devils have a high defence level. Although they have very high magic defence, they have a low magic level, which means most spells will still be reasonably accurate. A cannon is strongly recommended to lure the smoke devils, as their cave is extremely large and trying to stack them without one is significantly slower. Players who have obtained rewards from the elite tier of Combat Achievements should have enough cannonballs for one rotation to lure all the smoke devils, while those without may need to reload their cannon once to do so. Place the cannon in the centre of the dungeon and stack the smoke devils as they aggro, using the remains to the sides to stack them. Restore the stack when three or less smoke devils are left.
summary: A 93 Slayer task done only in the task-only Smoke Devil Dungeon south of Castle Wars (fairy ring BKP). You must wear a facemask or slayer helmet or their attacks always hit and drain stats; they attack with magical ranged, which Protect from Missiles fully negates. The cave is multicombat, so the usual method is to set a cannon in the centre to lure the devils, stack them behind the piles of remains and barrage them. Players wanting profit can instead kill the Thermonuclear smoke devil boss in its side room.

trainingSummary.cons: Luring smoke devils properly requires a lot of practice and effort.

locations.name: Sourhog Cave
locations.notes: Only location, 8 sourhog spawns; the cave entrance is just east of Draynor Manor. Sourhogs are aggressive to players of any combat level.

requiredItems: Reinforced goggles or Slayer helmet
strategy: A sourhog is a boar-like monster introduced in A Porcine of Interest. It requires reinforced goggles to kill, or a Slayer helmet after the quest. If no protection is worn, the caustic saliva they spit will burn the player's eyes, draining the player's current Attack and Defence by 90% and cause 20-30 damage each hit accompanied by the player exclaiming. Sourhogs are aggressive to players regardless of their combat level.

According to Spria, the sourhog was created when two farmers competed in a competition each year, with the same farmer winning each year. The other farmer, who was jealous of his rival, hired a dark wizard to alter one of his pigs, turning it into the Sourhog. This sourhog escaped and successfully bred more of its own kind. Sourhogs prefer to live in underground caves and in primitive tribes.
summary: A Spria-only beginner task fought in the Sourhog Cave just east of Draynor Manor after completing A Porcine of Interest. Wear reinforced goggles or a slayer helmet, otherwise their caustic spit hits 20-30 and drains Attack and Defence by 90%. They are level 37, aggressive regardless of combat level and use crush melee and ranged attacks, and a dwarf multicannon can be used in the cave.

exampleSetups.label: Sarachnis: Melee (Low level)
exampleSetups.notes:
As Sarachnis is weak to crush and has high magic and ranged defence, melee crush is the most viable method of killing her. Magic defence is prioritised due to two magic-using spawns that will appear during the fight. Aranea boots allow the player to avoid Sarachnis' web attack, but their cost may be prohibitive for lower level players. Without their use, it is beneficial to be prepared to swap to Protect from Missiles during the fight when outside of her melee range.

Inventory:

- Special attack weapon, such as Burning claws
- 1-2 Super combat potions
- 4-6 Prayer potions or super restores
- Teleport such as Xeric's talisman, House tablets, or Book of the Dead to reach the Forthos Dungeon
- Slash weapon to cut through webs, such as a Wilderness sword 1, unless wearing the aranea boots.
- House tablets or Ring of dueling for a one click teleport, stat restoration and access to a bank
- Book of the Dead for casting resurrection spells on the Arceuus spellbook
- Rune pouch with runes for Resurrect Greater Ghost
- The rest Cooked karambwans or better

Optionally:

- Death runes and Soul runes for Death Charge for more special attacks

Note: Players using Aranea boots do not need to bring a slash weapon for webs

exampleSetups.label: Sarachnis: Melee (High level)
exampleSetups.notes:
As Sarachnis is weak to crush and has high magic and ranged defence, melee crush is the most viable method of killing her. Magic defence is prioritised due to two magic-using spawns that will appear during the fight. It is highly recommended to bring aranea boots, as their unique mechanic will always free the player from Sarachnis' web attack, speeding up and simplifying the fight and negating the need to change prayer.

Inventory:

- Special attack weapon, such as Dragon claws
- 1-2 Divine super combat potions
- Saturated heart for magic defence
- 6-12 Prayer potions or super restores
- Sharks or higher tier food for remaining inventory space
- Book of the Dead for casting resurrection spells on the Arceuus spellbook
- Divine rune pouch with runes for thralls and Death Charge
- Teleport such as Xeric's talisman, House tablets, or Book of the Dead to reach the Forthos Dungeon
- House tablets for stat restoration and access to a bank

exampleSetups.label: Sarachnis: Magic (Tumeken's shadow)
exampleSetups.notes:
Tumeken's shadow's high accuracy and damage make it uniquely effective against Sarachnis when used with high-level magic equipment, although poor special attack weapons and lower melee defence lead to melee setups generally performing better overall.

While using Protect from Missiles and standing by the empty sarcophagus at the eastern side of the lair, the player will occasionally be out of the melee spawns' aggression range and outside of Sarachnis' melee range, and able to reach Sarachnis no matter where she is, negating the need for aranea boots.

Inventory:

- Saturated heart
- 6-12 Prayer potions or super restores
- Sharks or higher tier food for remaining inventory space
- Book of the Dead for casting resurrection spells on the Arceuus spellbook
- Divine rune pouch with runes for thralls
- Teleport such as Xeric's talisman, House tablets, or Book of the Dead to reach the Forthos Dungeon
- House tablets for stat restoration and access to a bank

exampleSetups.label: Venenatis: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
The Webweaver and Craw's bow offer competitive damage against Venenatis and Spindel despite their higher ranged defences. Ranged also has the luxury of staying closer to the exit in case of pkers, however you need to monitor and change your overhead prayers depending on the attack cycle. The Twisted bow and Bow of Faerdhinen are also both strong alternatives to some melee setups, although are generally not advised due the significant risk of being smited in multi-combat and from Venenatis' webs. Crossbows generally perform worse than most melee weapons, but offer the relative safety of being able to stay south of the entrance.

Inventory:

You should aim to take 4 valuable items you wish to keep if killed by another player, usually Craw's bow, Necklace of rupture, Slayer helmet (i) (on-task), and Dinh's bulwark provide the best balance of damage against Venenatis and survivability against other players.

- Dinh's Bulwark, Grey chinchompas, Darts/Throwing knives, or Blighted ancient ice sacks — kill spiderlings quickly, ordered from fastest to slowest
- Note that setting your Combat Options to defensive provides an invisble +5 level boost to your defence and also reduces non-pvp damage by 20% (with the Bulwark equipped) [Prevents attacking]
- The shield's animation will play when the wielder fails to block an incoming attack. This can alert the wielder to heal as it occurs prior to the hit landing.
- Looting bag
- Stamina potion
- Ranging potion
- Anti-venom/Sanfew serum(s) —…

exampleSetups.label: Venenatis: Example melee setup
exampleSetups.notes:
The aim is to maximise damage output while minimising risk. The protected items should be items that either grant very high melee strength bonus increases or a large percentage damage increase like the Slayer helmet (i). The ultor ring and the avernic defender both give major buffs to the player's offensive stats, and can be used along with cheaper items to deal high damage with limited risk. Items that can be easily replaced such as barrows gloves, amulet of strength, and dragonhide armour are wise choices as the chance of dying is fairly high.

If on a boss task, the player can use bracelet of slaughter to extend the task. This will affect damage output, but lower the player's risk slightly.

Items protected::

- Ultor ring
- Ursine chainmace / Viggora's chainmace — This adds between and to the value risked, as it uses revenant ether for charges. The DPS difference from Inquisitor's mace is significant.
- Avernic defender (Can be switched out to Book of War in order to use Dinh's bulwark, as this can be used to AoE minions and survive attacks from PKers)
- Slayer helmet (i) if on a slayer task

Items lost::

- Mixed hide boots and Mixed hide cape
- Black d'hide body and black d'hide chaps
- 1,500 Revenant ether
- Barrows gloves — Culinaromancer's Chest (or after completing the elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary)
- Amulet of strength
- Rada's blessing 4

exampleSetups.label: Venenatis: Example ranged setup
exampleSetups.notes:
The Masori body (f) can be traded out for a Black d'hide body and Dinh's bulwark for survivability and AoE damage against the spiderlings. Ranged allows the player to more easily damage the enemy for the duration of the entire fight, and stand closer to the door where it may be more safe. In lower risk gear, the damage output of the bow doesn't match up to melee; the difference is significant.

Additionally, due to the bows faster attack speed, the player consumes more revenant ether than if they were using melee. This is compounded by the longer fights with more hits. Because of this, extra ether is risked and used for slower fights, reducing potential profits.

As with melee, the player can use bracelet of slaughter to extend the task, if on a boss task for Venenatis. This will affect the player's accuracy and magic defence slightly.

Items protected::

- Slayer helmet (i)
- Webweaver bow / Craw's bow — This adds between and to the value risked, as it uses revenant ether for charges.
- Masori body (f) or Dinh's bulwark
- Necklace of anguish

Items lost::

- Mixed hide boots
- Black d'hide chaps and Black d'hide vambraces
- 1,700 Revenant ether
- Rada's blessing 4
- Ava's accumulator

exampleSetups.label: Venenatis: Inventory
exampleSetups.notes:
Inventory setup will vary greatly depending on your gear and team. When deciding what supplies to bring, keep in mind that Venenatis frequently drops large quantities of un-noted blighted food or potions that replace supplies used during the fight. Make sure to have the following:

- Dinh's Bulwark, grey chinchompas, blisterwood stakes, darts/throwing knives, or Blighted ancient ice sacks — kill spiderlings quickly, ordered from fastest to slowest
- Looting bag
- Stamina potion
- Divine/Super combat potion
- Anti-venom/Sanfew serum(s) — cures/prevents venom from player killers and poisonous spiders in the Escape Caves
- Blighted super restores
- Blighted manta ray or blighted anglerfish for the rest of the inventory, and multiple karambwan

Optional:

- Phoenix necklace — emergency healing whilst tanking
- Saradomin brews — more expensive outlast healing, combo eating with hard food is invaluable
- Royal seed pod — if not bringing a charged amulet of glory or ring of wealth
- Wilderness crabs teleport, Annakarl teleport (tablet), or Wilderness sword 4's fountain of rune — reach the Silk Chasm faster
- Blighted vengeance sacks, Vengeance runes, or runes for thralls and/or death charge - Death charge can be cast off cooldown with frequent minion spawns, this allows for ~1 Dragon warhammer spec every kill if solo.
- Divine rune pouch locked with a trouver parchment — if using Arceeus spellbook, allows for more supplies

exampleSetups.label: Araxxor: Melee
exampleSetups.notes:
While a scythe can provide faster kills, each swing costs coins. If the player is concerned about costs, they can opt for other crush weapons such as a soulreaper axe or inquisitor's mace, though kills will be slightly slower as a result.

Inventory:

- A special attack weapon, such as an elder maul or dragon claws
- A weapon to safely kill araxytes; a noxious halberd is recommended, even when using a mace (the mace is still able to one hit acidics)
- Extended anti-venom+ potions
- Prayer potions or super restore potions
- Super combat potions
- High healing food
- Combo food such as karambwans or halibut (optional, if struggling to heal fast enough - seek to replace with higher healing food when more skilled at the boss)
- Runes for Vengeance if on the Lunar spellbook, thralls and Death Charge if on Arceuus, or additional runes for Spellbook Swap if using both. If using both, a ring of shadows can be brought and uncharged to provide the needed blood, soul, death, and law runes.

exampleSetups.label: Araxxor: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
The twisted bow with Masori offers DPS better than the abyssal bludgeon and lower tier melee weapons, but is significantly outclassed by the scythe of Vitur.

Inventory:

- A special attack weapon, such as an elder maul for defence reduction or a Zaryte crossbow with ruby bolts (e) for damage.
- A heavy ballista to kill the mirrorback araxytes in one shot.
- Extended anti-venom+ potions
- Prayer potions
- Divine ranging potion
- High healing food
- Combo food such as karambwans or halibut (optional, if struggling to heal fast enough - seek to replace with higher healing food when more skilled at the boss)
- Runes for thralls and Death Charge

strategy: Spiritual creatures are a potential Slayer assignment given by medium and high-levelled Slayer Masters after completion of Death Plateau, a combat level of 60 and either 60 Strength or Agility with a minimum Slayer level of 63 in order to be assigned them.

There are three types of spiritual creatures players can kill as part of a task: spiritual rangers, the weakest at 63 Slayer, warriors at 68 Slayer, and mages, the only NPCs that drop dragon boots, at 83 Slayer.

These creatures are only found in the God Wars Dungeon and the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon. As followers of their respective gods, they are aggressive to anyone that is not wearing an item aligned to their god, but will be tolerant otherwise. This is essentially required, as the dungeons are multicombat areas with many monsters, likely resulting in a swift death if this is not met.
summary: Rangers (63 Slayer), warriors (68) and mages (83) found only in the God Wars Dungeon and the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon, both multicombat areas where nothing can be cannoned. Wear an item for each god whose followers you pass (at least Zamorak plus the god you are killing) so the dungeon stays tolerant, or you will be swarmed. The wiki suggests skipping or blocking rangers, killing warriors in Zamorak's Fortress and mages in Armadyl's Eyrie or the Ancient Prison, the latter being where the dragon boots-dropping mages are most concentrated. Many players block this task because it is slow, not AFKable and drops poorly.

trainingSummary.cons: Need to bring energy or stamina potions and restore potions if going to GWD via Trollheim due to chill, unless the Fire of Unseasonal Warmth has been built. Poor experience rates everywhere. Not worth doing for XP unless Slayer points are an issue.
trainingSummary.pros: Mages can give decent profit and have relatively low hitpoints (75 for Zamorak, 85 for Saradomin)

groups.text: Lunar Diplomacy started far enough to reach Lunar Isle

locations.name: South Lunar Isle
locations.notes: Four suqahs south-east (multi) and six south-west across the bridge (single-way). Three suqahs on the south-west part by the city wall are melee-only, so no prayer is needed for them, but one magic-using suqah is nearby; a cannon placed directly north-west of the dead tree targets the melee-only ones. locations.curatedName: Lady Zay - Cage on the bottom floor

locations.name: Lady Zay - Cage on the bottom floor
locations.notes: Listed as a Suqah LocLine: a single 27th suqah kept in a cage below the deck of the Lady Zay; not a practical task location.
requirements: Lunar Diplomacy started far enough to board the Lady Zay

requirements.other: Partial completion of Quest Lunar Diplomacy

strategy: Suqah can be a good Slayer task, due to the relatively high amount of experience per hour that can be gained from killing them with the help of a dwarf multicannon. However, the use of a dwarf multicannon and toxic blowpipe will also result in a loss of coins due to their lack of valuable drops.
If using the northern area on Lunar Isle, players should pray Protect from Magic and wear armour with high Melee defence, as these Suqah attack with both a melee attack and a magic attack.

Players wishing to avoid the magic damage should fight the suqah on the southern part of the island, such as near the Astral Altar, as these attack with only melee. There are also three melee-only suqah on the south-west part of the island, over the bridge (abutting the city wall); specifically, a cannon can be placed directly north-west of the dead tree to target the melee-only suqah while avoiding the single mage-dealing suqah in the vicinity.
summary: An 85 combat task from Nieve or Duradel done on Lunar Isle after starting Lunar Diplomacy. The northern suqahs are dense and multicombat, so most players cannon them from the safespot by the hill with Ranged while praying Protect from Magic against their Ice Barrage-style attacks; the sparser southern suqahs are melee-only and can be safespotted or meleed in Guthan's with no prayer. Drops are poor, so the wiki suggests blocking the task unless you want AFK experience, and a Seal of Passage is needed to bank unless you have done Dream Mentor or the elite Fremennik diary.

trainingSummary.cons: No notable drops to cover the cost of using the cannon. Requires good defensive armour as well as Protect from Magic since they hit hard with both attack styles.
trainingSummary.pros: Decent experience rates. Relatively fast task when unextended.
trainingSummary.recommendation: Do for XP; skip for profit

usefulItems: Prayer potions for Protect from Magic (north)
Seal of Passage (for the bank without Dream Mentor / elite Fremennik diary)

groups.text: Lair of Tarn Razorlor miniquest completed for more dogs to spawn

locations.name: Tarn's Lair
locations.notes: Hide in Tarn's room north of the dogs until they lose aggression (log out to check), then fight; a dog standing on the tile directly in front of the doorway can be safespotted with magic or ranged. The terror dog room drains prayer at 1 point per two game ticks (50 points per minute). The lair has traps and skeleton mages on the walk in; the banker Odovacar charges 100 coins per use.
requirements: Lair of Tarn Razorlor miniquest completed for more dogs to spawn

strategy: Terror dogs are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 40 (not boostable) to kill. Being the personal pets of Tarn Razorlor, they are first encountered during the miniquest Lair of Tarn Razorlor, in which the player must fight two terror dogs, alongside some animated armour in addition to Tarn himself. Upon completion of the miniquest, more terror dogs can be found in the room.

Terror dogs use an accurate melee attack. As the room they are fought in is a multi-combat area, fighting them can become very dangerous quickly, as multiple terror dogs can attack the player all at once.
Terror dogs do not count toward fulfilling a Slayer task for dogs; they are a separate task. They are the only monsters that drop the Granite helmet.

Players can hide in Tarn's room just north of the terror dogs and wait for them to develop tolerance to the player. This makes combating them significantly less risky. Be sure to log out to check for tolerance, as any dogs aggressive towards the player will remain so until the player exits Tarn's room, even if all other dogs are no longer aggressive. This will also cause all dogs targeting the player to stop and begin wandering around. Players can check to see if the dogs are still aggressive by exiting Tarn's room and waiting at the door for a quick retreat if they are.

It is possible to safespot the dogs from Tarn's room using magic or ranged. The dog must be standing on the tile directly in front of the doorway. Walking back and forth between the bookcases in the room while a dog is following you can help position the dog on the correct tile.

Terror dogs are similar to hellhounds in that they can hit hard and accurately, but have very low Defence. As the only area in which they are found is multi-combat, multiple terror dogs can attack at once. Players should be aware that the room that terror dogs are in at Tarn's Lair will drain prayer at a rate of 1 point per two game ticks, or 50 points per minute (much faster than the Barrows). Players cannot set up a cannon in the room.

Fighting terror dogs (mostly done for Slayer tasks) can be a difficult task for players who are unprepared. They can be safespotted if standing in the recesses after they have became tolerant of players.

High-level players, looking to fill the collection log for the Granite helm, may choose to bring their best ranged gear and a Venator bow to quickly dispatch the Terror dogs. Additionally, a Serpentine helm and Blowpipe can be worn initially to…
summary: A Vannaka-only task at 40 Slayer (not boostable) fought in the multicombat room at the end of Tarn's Lair, reached fastest with a Slayer ring teleport; access needs the Haunted Mine quest. They hit accurately with melee and several can attack at once, so the usual approach is to wait in Tarn's room until they become tolerant, or safespot them from that doorway with Ranged or Magic. Cannons cannot be set up in the lair.
usefulItems: Slayer ring (teleport straight to Tarn's room)
Food and prayer potions (the room drains prayer)
Salve amulet (Tarn's Lair page says the lair 'requires a Salve amulet to enter')

exampleSetups.label: Inventory recommendations
exampleSetups.notes:
- Armadyl brew can provide ranged boost, slot-efficient healing and overhealing.
- Prayer potions or super restores (can replace food with more potions if experienced)
- Ring of shadows for teleporting back, or Amulet of the Eye if scarred tablet has not been acquired yet
- Anglerfish are for boosting health before starting a kill to lessen interruptions during the volley of attacks, as well as chip damage from the roar attack
- Shadow Rush is just as effective as Shadow Barrage in stunning the boss, whilst costing only a third per spell cast
- A magic staff with autocast can be used to auto-cast Shadow spells. Thammaron's sceptre is a lighter weight option. Manually casting a spell is the same number of clicks, with the bonuses of saving an inventory slot and having a bigger click box in the spellbook tab by filtering out spells you lack the runes to cast.
- Twisted bow can optionally be used for the backside attack, as it usually deals higher damage than crossbow attacks due to the vastly increased minimum hit, especially with a Dizana's quiver so as to not require two inventory slots

Like a boss unlock (200 Slayer reward points)

locations.name: The Scar
locations.notes: Talk to the Catalytic Guardian in the Temple of the Eye, go east past the Abyssal Rift to Wizard Persten's camp and take the rowboat to the island; 'Climbing the handholds onto the platform initiates the fight momentarily.' (The Leviathan).
requirements: Completion of Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire
Like a boss unlock (200 Slayer reward points)

strategy: The Leviathan is a large sea creature found within the Scar, who is encountered during Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire. Once dwelling in the Eastern Ocean, the Leviathan was inadvertently dragged into the Scar during the Battle for the Eye when Perseriya of the Forgotten Four accidentally opened an abyssal rift in an attempt to teleport reinforcements in.

It has since then adapted to the abyssal environment and has made itself at home in a large lake within the Scar, preying upon those who were unfortunate enough to be pulled into the Scar during the battle. This is seen clearly on accounts of survivors and what remains of the Zarosian fleet in the area.
It is replaced by a stronger variant after completion of the quest which the player can repeatedly fight.
summary: A boss Slayer task (Like a boss unlock) for the Desert Treasure II sea creature fought on the island in the Scar, an area of Abyssal Space reached through the Catalytic Guardian in the Temple of the Eye.

exampleSetups.label: Inventory recommendations
exampleSetups.notes:
- Blackstone fragment
- Saturated heart or forgotten brews
- Special attack weapon
- An accursed sceptre helps reduce the boss's Magic level if it hits, making kills a bit faster, though this is completely optional. Otherwise, an eldritch Nightmare staff will help sustain trips far longer.
- The boss also drops a single 3-dose prayer potion and 2-dose ancient brew, which helps sustain trips even longer.
- Venator bow (with cheap arrows) or another fast ranged weapon for Lost Souls
- Rune pouch and Book of the Dead for thralls, or runes for ice spells (up to player preference)
- If using the standard spellbook, bring runes for your strongest earth spell; the Book of the Dead and Explorer's ring can be replaced with another super restore and runes for High Level Alchemy
- Ring of shadows for teleporting if sirenic tablet has been acquired
- Mind altar teleports are the next best alternative for those without a sirenic tablet.
- Fill rest of inventory with prayer potions or super restores (can replace with more food and/or combo eats, i.e. cooked karambwan, if inexperienced)
- Bluefin may be brought in place of other regular food to hold even more prayer, if desired.
- An Explorer's ring 4 can be helpful to alchemise the dragon plateskirts that are dropped at a rate of 1/100.
- The boss drops plenty of manta rays to help sustain food, assuming the player does not make too many mistakes. Even then, a single small mistake is often recovered with the Soul Siphon mechanic.

groups.text: Smoke devil task or Thermonuclear smoke devil boss task (one off-task kill allowed for the Western Provinces Diary)

locations.name: Smoke Devil Dungeon
locations.notes: Fairy ring BKP lands just south-west of the dungeon, or ring of dueling to Castle Wars and run south-west. Six smoke devils share the boss room; a peek option on the room entrance shows how many players are inside.
requirements: Smoke devil task or Thermonuclear smoke devil boss task (one off-task kill allowed for the Western Provinces Diary)

requiredItems: Facemask or Slayer helmet
strategy: The thermonuclear smoke devil, often referred to as thermy, is the boss version of the smoke devil. It requires a minimum of 93 Slayer to damage. Located at the Smoke Devil Dungeon south of Castle Wars, the Thermonuclear smoke devil can only be attacked on a smoke devil task, with the exception of one kill for the Western Provinces Diary (provided that the player has 93 Slayer without boosting).
It is the only monster to drop the smoke battlestaff, jar of smoke, and the pet smoke devil. It drops the occult necklace at a higher rate than smoke devils.
Unlike most NPCs, the Thermonuclear smoke devil is always able to walk through other monsters/players. This is to prevent players from safespotting the boss using the smoke devils found in its lair.
summary: The boss version of the smoke devil, fought in its side room of the task-only Smoke Devil Dungeon south of Castle Wars; it needs 93 Slayer and either a smoke devil task or a boss task, plus a facemask or slayer helmet.

exampleSetups.label: Melee (Ice trolls)
exampleSetups.notes:
Ice trolls are slightly resistant to slash attacks, making stab and crush weapons typically favoured here. When combined with a Dwarf multicannon, killing ice trolls can be a reasonably fast task with reasonable drops, although care needs to be taken due to the unavoidable damage.

- Inventory

- Dwarf multicannon and steel cannonballs
- 2 Divine super combat potions or Super combat potions
- Prayer potions
- Bonecrusher necklace to save on prayer potions
- A Seed box to pick up seeds
- Soul bearer to bank ensouled heads
- One-click teleport (optional)
- Enchanted lyre(i)
- Herb sack to pick up valuable herbs
- Divine rune pouch / Rune pouch with Fire and Nature runes to cast High Alchemy (set warning value to 50,000)
- Food (Sharks / Karambwans / Monkfish)

exampleSetups.label: Melee (Mountain trolls)
exampleSetups.notes:
Meleeing mountain trolls is an easy and accessible option for a Troll task with no quest requirements to complete, and with all damage able to be completely negated through Protect from Melee.

Protect from melee and Piety are strongly recommended, although forgoing one or both and using Bones to peaches is viable, albeit significantly slower. Thralls and Death charge on the Arceuus spellbook can be used to speed up the task significantly, in addition to a Dwarf multicannon. This also allows players to use Adept reanimation on any ensouled troll heads received on the task.

Players may also wish to use equipment such as Sunfire fanatic armour, Proselyte, or Initiate armour to maximise prayer bonus, especially if combined with a Bonecrusher necklace to minimise prayer potion usage.

- Inventory

- Dwarf multicannon and steel cannonballs
- 2 Divine super combat potions or Super combat potions
- 6 Prayer potions
- A Seed box to pick up seeds
- Soul bearer to bank ensouled heads (optional, if not using Adept reanimation)
- One-click teleport (optional)
- Teleport to get to Mount Quidamortem if not using a mounted Xeric's talisman
- Herb sack to pick up valuable herbs
- Divine rune pouch / Rune pouch with runes for High Alchemy or Thralls
- Food (optional, not needed with Protect from Melee)

strategy: TzHaar are an ancient race dwelling underneath the Karamja Volcano in Mor Ul Rek that can be assigned as a Slayer task if the player has unlocked the perk Hot Stuff for 100 slayer points.

TzHaar come in four varieties: the artisans TzHaar-Hur, the sages TzHaar-Mej, hunters TzHaar-Xil, and guards TzHaar-Kets. Killing any of these while wearing a charged ring of wealth increases their chances of dropping gems (and Onyx bolt tips for level 221 TzHaar-Kets).

The Hur and Ket primarily attack with melee, while the Xil can use either melee or ranged, depending on the weapon they are using; those wielding Toktz-xil-ul (resembling a throwing disc) will be able to use both styles, while those wielding Toktz-xil-ak or Toktz-xil-eks use only melee. strategy: Venators can be assigned as a Slayer task, exclusively by Mortimer once the player has completed The Blood Moon Rises. Alternatively, after spending 80 Slayer points and unlocking the Actual Vampyre Slayer perk, they can be killed while on a Vampyre task assigned by Konar, Duradel, Nieve, and Chaeldar. Mazchna and Vannaka can also assign Vampyres as a Slayer task by default, though in much lower quantities. Venators can only be found in Vampyrium, in the designated hunting grounds to the south of the entrance portal.

Venators are classified as tier 3 Vampyres, meaning they require the Ivandis flail as a minimum in order to damage them. Other superior weapons, such as blisterwood, the hallowed flail and sunspear will also work. Efaritay's aid is highly recommended for slaying venators, as it provides additional accuracy and damage that stacks on top of the slayer helm, meaning that attacks are much more accurate and stronger compared to using standard rings such as the treasonous or ultor rings. Each Efaritay's aid costs and comes with 200 charges, meaning that each charge costs coins, which is well worth the cost for most players.

They melee when adjacent and range otherwise, so pray the matching protection prayer, but turn prayer off during their screech, which damages and drains prayer from anyone using a protection prayer. Efaritay's aid is highly recommended because its accuracy and damage stack with the slayer helmet. Apsul has spawns closer to the altar; Virer has more spawns and is less crowded.

exampleSetups.label: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
The Webweaver and Craw's bow offer competitive damage against Venenatis and Spindel despite their higher ranged defences. Ranged also has the luxury of staying closer to the exit in case of pkers, however you need to monitor and change your overhead prayers depending on the attack cycle. The Twisted bow and Bow of Faerdhinen are also both strong alternatives to some melee setups, although are generally not advised due the significant risk of being smited in multi-combat and from Venenatis' webs. Crossbows generally perform worse than most melee weapons, but offer the relative safety of being able to stay south of the entrance.

Inventory:

You should aim to take 4 valuable items you wish to keep if killed by another player, usually Craw's bow, Necklace of rupture, Slayer helmet (i) (on-task), and Dinh's bulwark provide the best balance of damage against Venenatis and survivability against other players.

- Dinh's Bulwark, Grey chinchompas, Darts/Throwing knives, or Blighted ancient ice sacks — kill spiderlings quickly, ordered from fastest to slowest
- Note that setting your Combat Options to defensive provides an invisble +5 level boost to your defence and also reduces non-pvp damage by 20% (with the Bulwark equipped) [Prevents attacking]
- The shield's animation will play when the wielder fails to block an incoming attack. This can alert the wielder to heal as it occurs prior to the hit landing.
- Looting bag
- Stamina potion
- Ranging potion
- Anti-venom/Sanfew serum(s) —…

exampleSetups.label: Example melee setup
exampleSetups.notes:
The aim is to maximise damage output while minimising risk. The protected items should be items that either grant very high melee strength bonus increases or a large percentage damage increase like the Slayer helmet (i). The ultor ring and the avernic defender both give major buffs to the player's offensive stats, and can be used along with cheaper items to deal high damage with limited risk. Items that can be easily replaced such as barrows gloves, amulet of strength, and dragonhide armour are wise choices as the chance of dying is fairly high.

If on a boss task, the player can use bracelet of slaughter to extend the task. This will affect damage output, but lower the player's risk slightly.

Items protected::

- Ultor ring
- Ursine chainmace / Viggora's chainmace — This adds between and to the value risked, as it uses revenant ether for charges. The DPS difference from Inquisitor's mace is significant.
- Avernic defender (Can be switched out to Book of War in order to use Dinh's bulwark, as this can be used to AoE minions and survive attacks from PKers)
- Slayer helmet (i) if on a slayer task

Items lost::

- Mixed hide boots and Mixed hide cape
- Black d'hide body and black d'hide chaps
- 1,500 Revenant ether
- Barrows gloves — Culinaromancer's Chest (or after completing the elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary)
- Amulet of strength
- Rada's blessing 4

exampleSetups.label: Example ranged setup
exampleSetups.notes:
The Masori body (f) can be traded out for a Black d'hide body and Dinh's bulwark for survivability and AoE damage against the spiderlings. Ranged allows the player to more easily damage the enemy for the duration of the entire fight, and stand closer to the door where it may be more safe. In lower risk gear, the damage output of the bow doesn't match up to melee; the difference is significant.

Additionally, due to the bows faster attack speed, the player consumes more revenant ether than if they were using melee. This is compounded by the longer fights with more hits. Because of this, extra ether is risked and used for slower fights, reducing potential profits.

As with melee, the player can use bracelet of slaughter to extend the task, if on a boss task for Venenatis. This will affect the player's accuracy and magic defence slightly.

Items protected::

- Slayer helmet (i)
- Webweaver bow / Craw's bow — This adds between and to the value risked, as it uses revenant ether for charges.
- Masori body (f) or Dinh's bulwark
- Necklace of anguish

Items lost::

- Mixed hide boots
- Black d'hide chaps and Black d'hide vambraces
- 1,700 Revenant ether
- Rada's blessing 4
- Ava's accumulator

exampleSetups.label: Inventory
exampleSetups.notes:
Inventory setup will vary greatly depending on your gear and team. When deciding what supplies to bring, keep in mind that Venenatis frequently drops large quantities of un-noted blighted food or potions that replace supplies used during the fight. Make sure to have the following:

- Dinh's Bulwark, grey chinchompas, blisterwood stakes, darts/throwing knives, or Blighted ancient ice sacks — kill spiderlings quickly, ordered from fastest to slowest
- Looting bag
- Stamina potion
- Divine/Super combat potion
- Anti-venom/Sanfew serum(s) — cures/prevents venom from player killers and poisonous spiders in the Escape Caves
- Blighted super restores
- Blighted manta ray or blighted anglerfish for the rest of the inventory, and multiple karambwan

Optional:

- Phoenix necklace — emergency healing whilst tanking
- Saradomin brews — more expensive outlast healing, combo eating with hard food is invaluable
- Royal seed pod — if not bringing a charged amulet of glory or ring of wealth
- Wilderness crabs teleport, Annakarl teleport (tablet), or Wilderness sword 4's fountain of rune — reach the Silk Chasm faster
- Blighted vengeance sacks, Vengeance runes, or runes for thralls and/or death charge - Death charge can be cast off cooldown with frequent minion spawns, this allows for ~1 Dragon warhammer spec every kill if solo.
- Divine rune pouch locked with a trouver parchment — if using Arceeus spellbook, allows for more supplies

exampleSetups.label: Spindel: Ranged
exampleSetups.notes:
Both the webweaver bow and Craw's bow offer very competitive damage against Spindel despite her higher ranged defences. Ranged also has the luxury of staying closer to the exit in case of player killers, although you will need to monitor and change your overhead prayers depending on the attack cycle. The twisted bow and bow of Faerdhinen are also both strong alternatives to some melee setups, but the former is generally not recommended due to the higher likelihood of being smited from PKers and Spindel's webs. Crossbows generally perform worse than most melee weapons, but offer some relative safety by being able to stay south of the entrance.

Inventory:

- Royal seed pod acts as a one-click emergency teleport from up to level 30 Wilderness
- Super restore potions can be used in place of blighted super restores
- Blighted manta ray or blighted anglerfish (if the player is 93 or higher hitpoints) for the rest, and multiple blighted karambwan

strategy: Venenatis is a large spider that resides in the Silk Chasm, at level 35 Wilderness.
According to Phabelle Bile, Venenatis is the last of her kind, who were hunted to extinction by dwarves.
A dwarf multicannon cannot be set up in the Silk Chasm; if attempted, you will receive the message:

Venenatis attacks with melee towards any player that's adjacent to her, and either magic or ranged for any player out of her melee range. Protection prayers will fully block the attacks, however, they will have their effectiveness reduced for every spiderling alive in the chamber.
Every four attacks, Venenatis will shuffle to another position in her lair. Every two movements will cause her to alternate between ranged and magic attacks.

When a kill starts, Venenatis begins by summoning two spiderlings, who also increase her max hit along with reducing prayer effectiveness. The spiderlings will drain prayer by 1 for every hit made regardless if it damages or not, however they only have 5 health and players will deal their max hit on them regardless of gear. Venenatis can also launch a sticky web that if stood on, damages and drains prayer by 3 and run energy by 10 every few ticks. Venenatis will always alternate between the spiderlings and the sticky web after moving around twice.
If there are more than 10 players in Venenatis' lair, she will move more often and perform a special attack every time she moves, as opposed to every other time.
summary: Venenatis is the Wilderness spider boss in the Silk Chasm, a level 35 Wilderness multi-combat lair south-east of Callisto's Den that needs the medium Wilderness diary or a Venenatis boss task plus a shared 50,000 coin lair fee; Spindel can be killed instead.

The Ursine chainmace is by far the most effective weapon against Vet'ion, but comes with additional risk as it must be charged with Revenant ether. Players should choose three (or four, with Protect item if you are confident you can mitigate the risk of being Smited) valuable with the most strength bonus possible compared to cheaper alternatives.
